You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses. Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait. Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. Â The Opportunity Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own. We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live. jobs.title: Junior Business Development Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Welche Unternehmen sprechen wir als Nächstes an, und auf welchem Weg? Das entscheidest Du mit. Die WTE Group baut Unternehmen gegen den Fachkräftemangel. Mit WTE Charkos bringen wir Fachkräfte aus Indien nach Deutschland, mit B2-Deutsch vor dem ersten Gespräch und eigenem Ausbildungszentrum in Mysore. Gestartet sind wir in der Pflege, zu unseren Kunden gehören Universitätskliniken. Jetzt öffnen wir das Modell für weitere Branchen. Du sorgst dafür, dass wir dort die richtigen Unternehmen finden und erreichen: mit Recherche, Kampagnen und Messen. Was Du machst Du findest Unternehmen und Einrichtungen, die Fachkräfte suchen, recherchierst die richtigen Ansprechpersonen und baust daraus die Listen für unser Sales-Team. Das ist am Anfang der Schwerpunkt Deiner Arbeit. Du planst und versendest Newsletter und Briefkampagnen an Entscheider. Du bereitest Messen und Veranstaltungen vor und nach. Du pflegst unser CRM (Pipedrive) und wertest aus, welche Zielgruppen und Kanäle zu Terminen führen. Du erschließt gemeinsam mit den Gründern neue Branchen und arbeitest dabei mit KI-Tools. Was Du mitbringst Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung. Erste Erfahrung in Vertrieb oder Marketing ist willkommen, aber kein Muss. jobs.description: <p>SumUp is already live in 38 markets and still growing. Our Global Expansion Team takes SumUp's payment products into new countries, with Mexico and Canada among our most recent launches and more markets like New Zealand and Argentina on the way. As a QA Engineer in our Berlin payments team, you'll build the automated and manual tests that decide when a new card reader can go live in a market, across frontend, backend and mobile flows, and you'll also help complete L3 certification (the final round of testing that acquiring banks and card networks require). It's hands-on engineering work with real launch impact, because your tests help new markets go live and recently launched ones stay stable, so small businesses there can take card payments with integration and regression checks, plus edge cases and recovery scenarios.</li> <li>Spot ways to improve how we test, explain why they matter and make a convincing case for the changes with the biggest payoff</li> <li>Trace failures through complex payment flows using logs and transaction traces, then raise clear, prioritised defects and work with engineers and external partners until as well as acquirers, card schemes and certification labs.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Programming or scripting skill to build and maintain automated tests for frontend web and backend APIs, and comfort reading code in languages such as Golang, Kotlin, Java or others on our <a href="https://www.sumup.com/en-us/how-we-work/the-sumup-tech-radar/">Tech Radar.</a></li> <li>Experience testing software both manually and with automation, including turning requirements into test scenarios and deciding what to automate first based on customer, launch and technical risk.</li> <li>Ability to analyse logs, transaction traces and test results, and to write defect reports that include reproduction steps, expected versus actual behaviour, impact and evidence.</li> <li>Comfort working with Git and Jira (or similar tools)</li> <li>Experience with SQL and test-data setup, contract testing, mocking or service virtualisation.</li> <li>An engineering mindset: the ability to spot what can be improved, explain the reasoning and persuade others with clear evidence</li> <li>A curious, ownership minded approach: seeking out context when things are unclear and using AI tools where they help.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with Card payments, payment terminals, acquirers, card schemes or certification labs.</li> <li>Market launches, device integrations, external technical partners or business-to-business communication.</li> </ul> <p>Payments experience is helpful but not required. jobs.title: Account Executive, Mid-Market - DACH
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2.1B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from € 10k to € 300k , selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place. Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis). You should apply if:  You want to impact the industries that run our world : Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting : The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. You have innate curiosity in how businesses work : One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. You are a life-long learner : Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. You build genuine relationships with your customers : The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best : Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. In this role you will: Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline. Get In Early: The DACH Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.  Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer. Minimum Requirements for the role: Winning DNA: Minimum 18 months+ closing experience in an outbound-heavy SaaS environment. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch. Over-achievement: A track record of hitting and

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2.1B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from € 10k to € 300k , selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place. Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis). You should apply if:  You want to impact the industries that run our world : Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting : The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. You have innate curiosity in how businesses work : One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. You are a life-long learner : Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. You build genuine relationships with your customers : The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best : Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation. Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time. Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership. Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home. Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest. About RobCo Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model. We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. jobs.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results. The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic. About the Role Most software engineers never see their code tested against reality. At Swarm Aero, that's the baseline. We are looking for a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to own multiple initiatives across our customer programs and lead the forward deployed engineers working on them. You will work directly with U.S. government and military customers to understand the mission, decide what our C2 and onboard autonomy software can deliver, and set the technical plan to get it into the field. You will make the feasibility calls, keep everyone involved working from the same plan, and make sure your initiatives are ready for the releases that put new capability in operators' hands. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will still write code, debug systems in the field, and be on site when the work goes live. What You'll Do Own multiple initiatives within a customer program, from early requirements through deployment. Turn mission needs into a technical roadmap for each one, and make the feasibility and tradeoff calls across them. Lead the forward deployed engineers working on your initiatives by setting technical direction, breaking down the work, and clearing blockers. Write and integrate C2 and onboard autonomy software for unmanned air and sea vehicles, and debug it in the field when something breaks. Participate in and lead design reviews for your initiatives before work starts. Run post-incident reviews after field issues, find the root cause, and put fixes in place so the same problem does not happen again. Bring field data and lessons learned back to the core product team. Work with partner teams to align on priorities and timelines, gather their feedback, and run internal testing before every deployment. Plan how your initiatives fit into each contract release alongside core product work, and make sure they are tested and ready before the release ships. Serve as the main technical contact for vehicle and sensor vendors, and lead the integration of their systems with ours. Define success criteria with customers for each event, run the readiness review for your initiatives beforehand, and give the go/no-go recommendation. Mentor forward deployed engineers and help with technical assessments of potential candidates. Support deployments outside normal hours, including on-call response and rotational coverage aligned to mission tempo. Travel domestically and internationally (up to 50%) to test sites and customer locations, and lead the team on site. This Role Is For You If You have shipped software to the field and want to own a bigger share of the outcome. You like making technical calls under pressure and explaining them to people who need a straight answer. You enjoy helping other engineers grow while staying hands-on yourself. You can turn an ambiguous customer request into a plan a team can execute. This Role Is NOT A people management role away from the code A program or project management role A pilot position or vehicle operator role Primarily hands-on hardware work (electronics, wiring, mechanical assembly) Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated ability Experience leading a small team, feature crew, or sub-progra

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Intern
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe's fastest-growing fusion company and the continent's best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world's first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life's best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT Building a fusion power plant is one of the most capital-intensive projects in Europe, and every major decision at Proxima rests on our financial models. Our Strategic Finance team owns the long-term investment model, the multi-year business plan, and the financial modelling behind our fundraising, government funding, and corporate development deals. As our Strategic Finance Intern, you will be a second pair of eyes on these models, making sure they are accurate, consistent, and speak from one source of truth. You will work directly with the Strategic Finance lead and partner with the wider finance team and department heads. WHAT YOU WILL DO Review and reconcile our models: Work through our long-term investment model and multi-year business plan, check formula integrity and cross-sheet consistency, and reconcile both against our budget. Find and resolve discrepancies: Keep a clear log of every mismatch you find, trace it to its cause, and work with the relevant teams to resolve it. Document how the models fit together: Write clear handover documentation on how our models connect and where each input comes from, so the next person can pick them up quickly. Build tools the team will use: Create dashboards and automations on top of the reconciled models to enable the business operations team and the rest of the business to quickly find answers to their finance questions. WHO YOU ARE Modelling experience: Hands-on financial modelling experience, ideally from investment banking, private equity, venture capital, transaction services, or a finance role at a startup. Excel and spreadsheet fluency: You can trace logic through models someone else built, spot errors quickly, and suggest improvements. Experience with Excel macros or Google Apps Script is a plus. Independent problem-solving: You structure a messy question, reason from the data in front of you, and work through blockers without needing step-by-step guidance. Confidence to flag problems: You tell a team lead when their numbers don't tie, clearly and constructively, and own your mistakes when you make them. AI-native: You use AI tools such as Claude to work faster and build better tools, not as a replacement for doing the thinking. Startup mindset: Curious, proactive, and detail-oriented. You welcome feedback, enjoy working with others to help the team succeed, and are excited by fusion energy. Availability: You can start immediately and commit to 2-3 months on-site in Munich. Fluent English is required; German is a plus. Don't tick all the boxes? We would still like to hear from you! INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30 min) Tech

jobs.title: Tech Recruiter
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. Andercore is one of LinkedIn’s Top 10 Startups in Germany – and we’re just getting started. We’re looking for an ambitious Technical Recruiter to own and shape our tech hiring journey. From discovering exceptional talent to winning them over and closing the deal, you’ll take the lead in building world-class teams across Software Engineering, Data and Product. This is more than filling roles. It’s about setting the talent bar, shaping our culture, and bringing together the people who will define Andercore’s next chapter of growth. You’ll have the ownership, influence and opportunity to make a real impact from day one. What you'll do Own the full cycle: from kickoff to signed contract. Intake, sourcing, screening, offer, close: it's all yours. Hunt the people who aren't looking yet, via LinkedIn, GitHub, tech communities, meetups and referrals. Interview alongside our engineers and deliver sharp shortlists, fast, with zero compromise on quality. Close: negotiate offers, beat counter-offers and keep candidates fired up until day one. Advise hiring managers as a true partner on the tech market, salaries and timelines, and drive fast decisions. Track everything in Ashby and own the numbers: pipeline, conversion and time-to-hire. You'll thrive here if you have Drive and ownership. No hand-offs, no excuses. Every open role is yours until it's signed. Curiosity. You speak the language of engineers, test new channels, tools and outreach, double down on what works and drop what doesn't. Hunger to learn. You want to grow fast in a scale-up where things change weekly, and you love it that way. What you bring Fluent English communication. 1–3+ years in recruiting (agency or in-house), ideally hiring software engineers, data or product people Proven direct sourcing and closing skills, and a solid grasp of tech roles and stacks Bonus: start-up or scale-up experience, an energy or B2B background, Ashby know-how. jobs.description: Software Engineer, Research Platform About Us Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how. Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData and our Trillion Gene Atlas (TGA), the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development. In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100. At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today. The Role We're seeking an exceptional Software Engineer, Research Platform to join our team in London, embedded in our AI, genomics and computational biology teams. Your goal is to accelerate their research by bringing production-grade engineering to the systems they depend on. This is an embedded role. You'll sit with the scientists, understand what they are trying to find out, and build the systems that get them there faster: making research code reliable, reproducible and fast; designing data pipelines and workflows that run at the scale of BaseData and the Trillion Gene Atlas; and building the tools and infrastructure that let a small research team run far more experiments. You'll move between genomics, computational biology and ML work as the research requires, and own what you build end to end. The engineering problems are substantial: petascale biological data, workflows that span cloud and HPC, and research that is often limited by how quickly an idea can be turned into a result. You'll report to the Head of Platform as part of our engineering team, which spans London and Boston, and work day to day within the AI research, genomics and computational biology teams in London. About you A very strong engineering background: complex production systems you have designed, built and owned. Expert in Python; strong habits around testing, code review and CI/CD. You take responsibility for the outcome. If that means learning something new or working outside your usual area, you do it. A solid understanding of data pipelines, workflow orchestration, distributed execution and scalable compute (Kubernetes, HPC, containers). You can take a researcher's code, understand the question behind it, and make it robust without losing what made it useful. A real interest in biology, ideally with experience of genomic, protein or sequencing data. You will learn the science well enough to understand the research, not just its code. Collaborative and low ego. We care about drive, and in a small team everyone depends on what you build. Nice to have Research or applied experience in computational biology, bioinformatics or genomics. Experience

jobs.title: Customer and Client Support Specialist
jobs.description: About Us Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. We run camera-based parking for landowners and operators, from hotels and colleges to shopping centres, across England, Scotland and Wales. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country. Role Overview We’re looking for a Customer and Client Support Specialist to join our support team in Croydon. You’ll help two groups of people: the drivers who park at our sites, and the landowners and asset managers we work with. Most of the job is email, through Zendesk. This isn’t answering from an FAQ. A good reply means reading the message properly, working out what’s actually being asked, checking the facts across our systems, and writing an answer that solves the problem without creating a new one. Some drivers will be angry, and some will be wrong but loud. We need someone who stays calm, gets it right, and follows up until it’s fixed. It’s a role for a “learn-it-all” who cares about getting small things right, ticket after ticket. Almost everything is teachable in your first couple of months, and there’s plenty of room to grow as the company does. Key Responsibilities Respond to driver and client enquiries by email, clearly, accurately and on time. Investigate each case properly before replying, checking details such as references, tariffs and permit lists. Keep accurate records of every interaction. Work with TechOps, Client Success and other teams on the trickier cases, and chase until they’re resolved. Spot issues that keep coming up and flag them to the team, rather than just closing your own ticket. Help build out and improve our processes as the team grows. Who we’re looking for You’ll need: Experience in a customer support or service role. Excellent written English: clear, polite, accurate and free of typos, with the right tone for the situation. A real eye for detail. You read carefully, check before you reply and notice when something doesn’t add up. Calm under pressure, including with rude or unfair customers. The ability to manage a busy queue and several priorities at once. Ownership: you close loops, chase what’s stuck and ask when there’s no clear answer. Openness to feedback and a willingness to learn. The ability to work independently and as part of a team. Nice to have: Experience with Zendesk and Jira. Experience in parking, mobility, utilities or another high-volume consumer service. What We Offer Hybrid working: 3 days in the office, 2 days from home. Room to grow with the business, with training, mentorship and exposure to technical operations. 20 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays. Company pension scheme. A fully refurbished, modern office right next to East Croydon Station, with a fully stocked kitchen offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks (and two office dogs!). Laptop and tech provided. Employee Assistance Programme, BrightHR Exchange discounts and regular company events. The details Location: Croydon, next to East Croydon Station. Hybrid: 3 days in the office, 2 from home. Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 6:00pm. Salary: £26,000 - £28,000 (Negotiable) Reports to: Customer Support Manager. Team: Customer and Client Support (CS/DS). jobs.description: We’re hiring an analyst to open first conversations with investors who are new to Pairs, and to book their meetings with the founders we work with. About Pairs Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout US founders, from seed to Series B, in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who know their market and can open the doors they need. We work only with the top 1% of deals, vet every founder and investor before they join, and invest our own money alongside our investors in a few of the companies we believe in most. The role You help grow the investor side of Pairs. From your first week you’re on calls with investors who are new to Pairs, learning what they invest in and why, and matching them with founders who fit. Family offices and private wealth are the investors we most want more of, and VCs are still a big part of what we do. Pairs has made more than 3,500 investor introductions for founders since we started. You don’t need a network of US startup investors to start; we bring the investors to you and coach you on building relationships with them. Software and AI run the admin, so the role isn’t technical and your time goes to people. Analysts who do well here move up to associate and run their own book of investors. What you will own • First conversations every week with investors who are new to Pairs. • Qualifying each investor: what they invest in, at what stage, and how much. • Booking meetings between our founders and the investors who fit them. • Keeping your growing list of investor relationships warm, with the goal of building your own book. • Support for our associates and senior team on live deals, which means researching investors, writing briefing notes before a meeting and following up after it. You are a fit if you • Have worked a job or an internship where you spoke to investors or senior clients yourself, for example at an expert network, consultancy, bank, wealth manager or fund. • Have built relationships yourself and became someone’s go-to contact, even if the first introduction came through your employer. • Have found your own way to a first conversation, through alumni, former colleagues or your own outreach. • Can research a company or an investor quickly and turn it into a clear, short briefing. • Use AI tools every day to speed up research and repetitive work, while keeping the relationship side human. • Communicate clearly and with confidence, on calls and in writing. • Build trust by listening first and respecting an investor’s time. • Handle confidential deal and investor information with care. • Have hit a target that was yours alone, at work or in something you started. jobs.title: Solutions Lead
jobs.description: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the role We’re looking for a Solutions Lead to help build Ramp’s solutions function for our international business, starting with the UK and Europe. This is a hands-on builder role. You’ll be a trusted technical partner to prospects, customers and channel partners, shaping how we sell, implement and support complex solutions as the business grows. This is broader than a traditional pre-sales role. Winning complex opportunities is central to the job, but your impact won’t end at signature. You’ll connect technical discovery with implementation readiness, help resolve high-stakes customer challenges, enable partners, and build the demos, playbooks and technical expertise that make the wider team more effective. You’ll combine technical depth, commercial judgement and a strong understanding of finance workflows to solve the most important problems yourself and build repeatable approaches so the business becomes less dependent on any one person. You don’t need an engineering background; what matters is your ability to understand systems, solve technical problems and communicate clearly. You’ll also have the opportunity to help customers navigate an evolving platform, including areas such as Accounts Receivable, Stack and our AI-powered products: Router, Glass and Inspect. jobs.title: Product Security Engineer
jobs.description: In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone. In eight years time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over two million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year. What is the role about As a fast paced, highly targeted and highly regulated company, security is more important here than most other companies. That means your impact can be much more material, this role is about working with our brothers and sisters in product and engineering and building security through collaboration. It’s about being an engineer who knows how to use automation and tooling to get more done at pace and to scale security’s impact. The role includes ‘whole of product’ security - Application, architecture and infrastructure. You’ll understand deeply the threats posed to us by threat actors and where to focus our attention, you’ll be the kind of person who enjoys building long lasting relationships, making impact by really moving the needle and scaling through automation so you are always focussed on the highest value work. How will you make an impact Threat modelling: Taking an attackers lens on what’s being built and understanding how it could be abused/targeted and being able to bring others on the journey through clear communication. Pen testing/Red teaming/Vuln discovery: Being the threat actor but with a whitebox approach, thinking about what tools can you build to help scale these processes. Thinking about how we bring in more data to find the right issues and surface them with appropriate prioritisation. Communication and relationships: Bringing teams on side by working together with the attackers lens, collaboratively designing best of breed security controls that mitigate threads and support the business and our customers by making them as slick as possible. Going deep on existing MO’s and industry attack knowledge : Understanding deeply the attackers, their motivations and evolving techniques, performing evaluations of our controls to ensure they hold up, continuously iterating and educating. How will you be successful? Backend/frontend development background with a transition into security engineering 5+ years of experience in secure software development and AppSec Demonstrable record of delivering real world security improvements Deep experience of scaling security through automation including AI and slick processes Experience with Kubernetes, containers and CI/CD Strong AWS and/or GCP experience Strong understanding of AuthN/AuthZ, API security, AI Security and OWASP Top 10 Experience with tools such as Burp, Wiz, Snyk, Semgrep, Bug bounty and SAST platforms Experience in fintech, payments, crypto or other regulated industries is a big plus Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think like an attacker to anticipate and prevent security issues Strong Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of presenting complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders Bug Bounty participation/Hall of fame/CVE IDs are a big plus Any security certifications are a plus (CISSP, CPTS, OSCP, AWS Security+) At Bitvavo, we believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, foster creativity, and lead to better outcomes. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ability, or any other characteristic. Join us and be part of a team that values and celebrates your unique contribution

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - React Native - Consumer Growth
jobs.description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. The opportunity Consumer Growth helps customers get more value from the Kraken app. We improve how people discover relevant features, build confidence using them, and keep coming back. We work closely with Product, Design and Data to understand customer behavior, identify opportunities and test ideas. Our engineers help shape what we build. You’ll bring ideas to the table, challenge assumptions and own your work from the initial hypothesis through launch, measurement and iteration. Ship fast experiments, from a couple of days to a couple of weeks, to improve conversion and retention in the Kraken app. Find funnel drop-offs and turn them into testable ideas, then build, measure and iterate. Design, develop and maintain high-quality React Native features for our consumer mobile app. Help customers discover and adopt relevant features through improvements to customer journeys, incentives and A/B tests. Use AI to build quickly, then review and ship with a high quality bar. Deliver polished, user-friendly UI that makes the product feel great to use. Build for correctness, accessibility, performance and reliability, with testing appropriate to the change. Work closely with Product, Design, Data and Backend Engineering to define hypotheses and measure results. Instrument your work so the team can evaluate customer behavior and experiment results, and use what you learn to improve, expand or stop an experiment. Turn successful experiments into reliable, maintainable product experiences. Proactively spot gaps and opportunities, and take ownership of the outcome. What you bring Strong experience building production mobile apps with React Native and TypeScript. A product and growth mindset, focused on moving metrics rather than just shipping code. Evidence of product impact: you can explain what you built, why you built it and what you learned after launch. Curiosity about data, and comfort using analytics tools such as Mixpanel and Segment. Experience working in a scale-up or other high-growth, fast-moving environment. Fluency in using AI tools to build, review and ship code, while retaining ownership of engineering decisions and the quality of the result. A strong eye for UI quality and polish. A self-directed approach, with the confidence to find problems and fix them without being asked. Comfort working from an ambiguous customer problem, proposing ideas and finding a small, useful change to test. Collaborative working style across Product, Design and Engineering. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Nice to haves Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiments, ideally with Statsig or a similar tool. Experience with large-scale consumer products used by millions of people. Agency or consulting background shipping across multiple products. Experience in consumer fintech, payments or crypto apps. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive - UK&I
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: We are currently seeking a talented and driven sales professional who will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be £20k to £200k, and typically involve technical POCs, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.  This is a remote position open to candidates based in United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. You should apply if:  You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.  You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.  This may not be the right role for you if:  You aren't willing to put in the work: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.  You aren't a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team. You have nothing more to learn : Every Samsarian has a growth mindset and believes that what got us here won't get us there. In this role, you will:   This is a pure hunter role focused on 90% net-new logo acquisition," and "Candidates must have a minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. Work on strategic account mapping & outbound prospecting Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close Work collaboratively with a team of internal / cross-functional stakeholders to remove deal blockers Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale global

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2>About the role</h2> <p>Our team builds, tests, deploys, and monitors the classifiers that block internal agents from taking dangerous actions. These classifiers run across RL, evals, and internal deployments, and are designed to catch things like sandbox escape attempts or exfiltration of sensitive data.</p> <p>When a classifier flags an action, it can <a href="https://www.anthropic.com/news/improving-alignment-security-efforts" target="_blank">block the action before the tool call runs, end the task, and alert a human</a>. This is one layer of a defence-in-depth with several layers that reinforce each other: what our classifiers flag feeds into offline monitoring, and the findings from that go back into better classifiers and safer environment design.</p> <p>The work combines research and production engineering:</p> <ul> <li> <p>The research problem is building high recall and high precision classifiers to catch rare, novel, and sometimes adversarial behaviour. There are also several narrow research questions to answer - for example, how to deploy safety classifiers inside training environments without incentivising models to evade them. Some research also builds on the multi-stage designs described in our work on <a href="https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/claude-code-auto-mode" target="_blank">Claude Code auto mode</a> and <a href="https://www.anthropic.com/research/next-generation-constitutional-classifiers" target="_blank">Constitutional Classifiers</a>.</p> </li> <li> <p>The engineering problem is shipping these classifiers into the critical path of research and product work. These classifiers need to cover a huge volume of traffic while operating within cost, latency and availability constraints.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Day to day, much of our work is done with Claude: you'll direct agents to run experiments and ship code, and review what they produce. That moves the hard part of the job towards deciding what to do and in what order. Additionally, organisation, communication, and prioritisation skills matter a great deal as our classifiers sit in the path of many other teams' work.</p> <h2>Key responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Design, train, and evaluate classifiers that detect unsafe agent actions in real time, owning pieces such as prompted models, trained classifiers, or probes on model internals</p> </li> <li> <p>Deploy, tune and operate these classifiers in the critical path of internal agents, RL training, and evaluations, and own their accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and failure behaviour</p> </li> <li> <p>Build the datasets, labelling pipelines, and evaluations that allow us to measure and improve our classifiers and harm taxonomies</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with red teaming colleagues to stress-test our classifiers, and harden them against what they find</p> </li> <li> <p>Work with the teams whose agents, environments, and evaluations we run on, so that false positives get fixed quickly without weakening protection</p> </li> <li> <p>Contribute to the team's direction, including what to build, what to partner on, and where to invest</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Mini

What you'll own Build and evolve the data platform. Own BeReal's data architecture end to end: ingestion, storage, orchestration, transformation, modeling, observability and access. jobs.title: Legal Counsel - Commercial and AI
jobs.description: About H: Our agents act on computers for our customers, clicking through software and filling in fields, so our contracts have to answer some awkward questions. Who owns what an agent produces? Who answers when an output turns out to be wrong? Can customer data train our models? Our terms already take a position on all three, and they're public: read our general terms of service and our data processing agreement , both in French, under French law, and last updated in June 2026. This job is drafting and negotiating contracts like these, and keeping them current as the product and the law move. H builds computer-use agents for enterprises, from Paris. In July 2026 we launched Computer-use Agents , fully managed agents that take actions on computers. What you own Our business teams bring in the deals. You'd write the paper behind them and lead the negotiation. When AI regulation or data protection law changes, you'd help work out what our contracts need to say now. You'd report to Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, who is also the data protection officer named in our DPA . What you'd be doing Drafting and advising on a wide range of contracts, AI service agreements among them, with customers, partners and suppliers. Working through the other side's mark-up. Our general terms cap our liability on paid services at the higher of €100 or the previous 12 months' fees, for example. When a customer's lawyers push on it, you'd work out where we hold. Then you'd make the argument. Turning new products and new AI law into contract changes and negotiation guidance. What we ship includes open-weight models: Holo3-35B-A3B is on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0, fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. Answering engineers and business teams on how to deploy AI within the rules. Customers can see on our Trust Center that we hold ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2 Type 1 and SOC 2 Type 2, and which subprocessors we use. When needed, questions outside contracts: employment, corporate or competition law. Who you'd work with Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, is hiring for this role. You'd join our Legal team and work closely with engineers and business teams. What we think it takes Likely a good fit if you Hold a master's in law and are admitted to the bar. Have a minimum of 3 to 5 years of relevant legal experience. Know data protection law well (GDPR and the rules around it), along with IP, contract law and liability, and regulatory compliance. Have worked somewhere that was growing fast. Can explain a legal position plainly to an engineer. Work well on your own and adapt when plans change. An international outlook matters here too. Stronger still if you built that experience negotiating contracts at a tech or AI company. You do not need to have worked at an AI company before. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway. How we hire Three conversations. First a 30 minute call with our Talent team, then 30 minutes with Julie, and last a conversation with a member of our leadership team. Practicalities It's a hybrid job: you'd be in Paris with the team for three days in an average week. We offer a competitive package. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Computational Biologist
jobs.description: About Proxima Proxima (formerly VantAI) is advancing an AI-native approach to drug discovery by making protein interactions programmable. Our platform brings together foundation-model machine learning, a scalable data generation engine, and a partnership track record exceeding $5B in collaborations across the world’s leading biopharma and tech organizations. We’ve recently closed an oversubscribed seed round partnering us with an elite group of sophisticated and dedicated VCs including DCVC, Nvidia’s Nventures, AIX, Yosemite among others. Neo-1 is our all-atom foundation model that combines state-of-the-art structure prediction and molecular generation in a single system. Neo-1 enables rapid exploration of chemical and structural space for high value, previously intractable targets, and in particular unlocks small molecule proximity therapeutics like molecular glues with AI for the first time. In parallel, we are developing an advanced structural interactomics platform built on proprietary XLMS technology and a lab equipped with next-generation mass spectrometry instrumentation. This platform produces proteome-scale maps of protein interactions and helps identify small molecules that modulate proximity. Together with Neo-1, it creates an integrated system capable of co-folding protein complexes while generating candidate small molecules to influence those interactions. Proximity-based therapeutics represent one of most promising frontiers in modern drug discovery with the potential to treat previously intractable diseases and target ‘undruggable’ proteins. Our technology combines proteome-scale structural data with state-of-the-art generative AI foundation models, and coupled with our talented team of scientists and engineers we are uniquely well-positioned to discover and develop a new class of medicines. Come join us! About You: Proxima is seeking highly-motivated Computational Biologists interested in building the leading AI-enabled drug discovery platform for novel induced proximity therapeutic modality. Successful candidates will work closely with the Computational Chemistry, Machine Learning and Application Engineering teams to tap into the wealth of evolutionary, structural and -omics data to unlock the full potential of unified machine learning representations and large-scale geometric deep learning generative models. Projects may include designing large-scale scientific workflows for mining public and unique in-house data; developing novel systems biology and structural biology computational methods, tools and algorithms; and/or designing, training and fine-tuning best-in-class machine learning models. In our projects we apply induced proximity approaches to some of the most challenging targets considered “undruggable” as well as discover, build and develop novel proximity platforms spanning across multiple targets and disease areas. We value individuals who want to make an impact, have a deep intellectual curiosity, enjoy solving challenging problems and have a track record of achievement. At Proxima, we believe that success is determined by talent and hard work, and individuals are given equal opportunities to grow and advance based on their abilities and contributions. Key Responsibilities: Develop pilot capabilities and create large-scale data pipelines from the ground up Collaborate with other teams across Proxima and partnering organizations to achieve project goals by contributing code, analyses, benchmarks, optimizations and ideas to ongoing research-driven projects Integrate biological insights into the next generation of AI/ML models for drug discovery Validate and interpret computational predictions by working closely with experimentalists Basic Qualifications: Hold an MSc or PhD degree in computational biology, bioinformatics or a related field Possess mixed academic and/or industrial experience, preferably in the biotech industry Have a strong background in computational structural or systems biology Demo

You own the customer end-to-end. You're the person they call, the person they trust, and the person whose name shows up when the contract gets renewed. Work with product and engineering to turn those blocks into services any customer can run on Omnilex. Maintain a portfolio of services you own and iterate with product and engineering until they are as good as the original work. Own the commercial relationship Be the named lawyer on the account. A genuine interest in legal craft and in how AI is changing the practice of law. Comfortable working with managing partners, GCs, engineers and founders. Native German and fluent English. French is a plus. Why join Omnilex You will do legal work that actually matters. Cases for the most sophisticated legal teams in Europe. You will own a portfolio of customer relationships with real commercial upside. You will productize your own legal expertise. The services you build outlive any single matter and compound across the platform. Competitive salary and transparent ESOP. You are early enough that ownership means something. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: About Unblu Unblu helps the world's leading banks and insurance companies deliver conversational finance solutions. We provide highly secure engagement and collaboration software, enabling financial institutions to enrich the digital experience of their clients. By choosing a career with Unblu you choose to join an international, and innovation-savvy company. With our head office situated in Basel, Switzerland and additional offices in Bulgaria, Germany, the UK, Canada and the USA, you’ll be joining an international team dedicated to shaping the future of digital engagement. While Unblu is run as an independent company with global scope, we are fortunate to have Swiss Post as our anchor shareholder, providing long term support and vision to the company.  The Role We're looking for a Security Engineer to work alongside our SRE and engineering teams, embedding security across the full software development lifecycle. You'll own a mix of defensive operations and developer-facing security tooling, from WAF rule management and CVE triage to building the pipelines that keep our deployments safe by default. This role sits at the intersection of application security, platform security and operations. You'll partner closely with engineering to ship secure software, and with SRE when things need to be hardened or investigated. We run entirely in the cloud, with a strong focus on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You'll report to our VP SRE. An on-call rotation shared with SRE may be part of this role; we'll finalize expectations with the successful candidate. Responsibilities Embed security practices throughout the software development lifecycle, from design review to production monitoring, working hands-on with engineering teams Build, maintain and evolve the security tooling in our GitLab CI/CD pipelines: SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, secret detection and container scanning Review Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) for our applications, track supply chain risk and drive remediation of issues in third-party components Own CVE triage end to end: assess relevance, prioritize based on exposure and exploitability, and coordinate remediation with product teams Manage and tune our Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules, balancing strong protection against false-positive noise Run internal security audits, document findings clearly and work with teams to close gaps Coordinate our annual external penetration test end to end; review pen test reports commissioned by our customers, translate findings into actionable work and respond back to the customer Lead the technical investigation, containment and recovery of security incidents together with SRE Provide technical evidence for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audits, DORA resilience testing and customer security questionnaires, together with our Compliance Manager Help run or grow our external bug bounty program (optional scope): triage reports, coordinate with researchers and drive fixes through engineering Requirements Practical, hands-on security experience in a SOC, incident response or security engineering context, where you've done the work, not just written policy A degree, recognized certification (OSCP, CISSP, GIAC or equivalent) or structured training in information security Comfortable working across the entire software lifecycle, shifting between developer collaboration, operations and governance Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally in GitLab CI Familiarity with vulnerability scanners, SBOM tools (Syft, Grype, Trivy, Dependency-Track or similar) and WAF platforms (Cloud Armor, Cloudflare or similar) Working knowledge of GCP security primitives (IAM, VPC Service Controls, Cloud Armor, Secret Manager, Binary Authorization, Security Command Center); comparable experience in another major cloud is fine if you're ready to go deep on GCP A clear communicator who can explain risk to engineers in terms they'll act on, and present confidently to customer security teams

jobs.title: hbo-stage Analyseren kwaliteit bouwvergunningen BAG
jobs.description: hbo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die nieuwsgierige en enthousiaste student die graag in data duikt en op zoek gaat naar opvallende patronen en verbanden? Krijg jij energie van het ontrafelen van complexe vraagstukken, het ontdekken van inzichten en het vertalen van data naar betekenisvolle resultaten? Dit is jouw uitdaging Het CBS ontvangt maandelijks van de 342 gemeenten in Nederland informatie over verleende bouwvergunningen. Gemeenten leveren deze gegevens aan via enquêtes en registreren de bouwvergunningen daarnaast in de Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG). Sinds 2025 publiceert het CBS de cijfers over bouwvergunningen op basis van de BAG. Er is echter een groot en toenemend verschil tussen de cijfers uit de BAG en de tellingen uit de enquêtes. Er is reeds onderzoek gedaan naar deze toenemende verschillen. Als stagiair ga je dit verder onderzoeken, door middel van een diepgaande analyse van de tijdigheid en kwaliteit van de registratie van gegevens in de BAG. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces om beter inzicht te krijgen in hoe de BAG zich verhoudt tot de werkelijkheid. Je onderzoekt onder andere: Hoe lang wachten gemeenten met registraties? Worden registraties doorlopend geregistreerd, of opgespaard en in korte tijd geregistreerd in de BAG? Verandert de kwaliteit en tijdigheid door de tijd heen? Om deze vragen te beantwoorden duik je in een grote database, waar je met behulp van SQL en R of Python trends gaat waarnemen, data visualiseert, en samenvattingen maakt. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces, en hoe dit is geïmplementeerd bij gemeenten. Voor deze taak is al eerder onderzoek gedaan, en is er ook al meer informatie beschikbaar. Je verzamelt deze resultaten in een rapport met een overzicht van de huidige stand van zaken. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag Ons team bestaat uit 24 enthousiaste collega’s, die met veel passie en plezier werken aan statistische informatie over vastgoed en de woningmarkt. We maken statistieken over (bouw)vergunningen, ontwikkeling van de woningvoorraad, (gemiddelde) WOZ-waardes, eigendomsverhoudingen, tijdelijke woningen, woningtransformaties en nog heel veel meer. We doen statistisch onderzoek op verzoek van organisaties in de publieke sector. En we beheren en verwerken data voor CBS-collega’s en werken samen met diverse organisaties, waaronder het Kadaster, de ministeries van BZK, VRO en EZK en Eurostat. We publiceren regelmatig over de dynamiek van de Nederlandse vastgoed- en woningmarkt. Onze nieuwsberichten halen regelmatig journaals, nieuwssites en voorpagina’s van landelijke dagbladen. En daar zijn we trots op! Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een hbo opleiding in de studierichting toegepaste wiskunde, data science of sociale wetenschappen. Je hebt affiniteit met de woningmarkt. Je hebt kennis en wellicht ervaring met R/rmarkdown en/of Python en SQL databases.  Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en enthousiast om met data aan de slag te gaan. Je vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen te ontdekken, neemt graag initiatief en denkt actief mee. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook graag de samenwerking op. Je deelt gemakkelijk je ideeën en bevindingen en staat open voor nieuwe inzichten en feedback. Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: samenwerkt met ervaren experts binnen hun vakgebied; gaat werken met grote databases (SQL); kennis opbouwt van de BAG en het registratieproces bij bronhouders; analyses samenvat in data visualisaties en overzichtelijke tabellen. Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken

jobs.title: Afstudeerstage AI Adoption
jobs.description: Wil jij helpen om AI van technologie naar dagelijks werk te brengen? Bij HG geloven we dat technologie mensen sterker maakt. Daarom hebben we de afgelopen periode een stevig fundament gelegd voor AI binnen onze organisatie. Microsoft Copilot is geïntroduceerd, er zijn verschillende AI-initiatieven gestart en steeds meer collega’s ontdekken wat AI voor hun werk kan betekenen. De volgende stap is opschalen. Want AI beschikbaar maken is één ding. Zorgen dat mensen het daadwerkelijk goed gebruiken, er nieuwe vaardigheden mee ontwikkelen en hun manier van werken aanpassen, is waar de echte transformatie plaatsvindt. Als afstudeerstagiair AI Adoption help je ons om die volgende stap te zetten. Je komt terecht in een internationale organisatie waar samenwerking, initiatief en nieuwsgierigheid centraal staan. Je begint dus niet vanaf nul. Je bouwt verder op wat er al staat en helpt ons te ontdekken welke aanpak nodig is om AI-adoptie verder te versnellen. Je combineert onderzoek met praktijk. Je analyseert hoe AI wordt gebruikt, vertaalt data naar concrete acties, ontwikkelt en geeft trainingen voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus en helpt collega’s om AI steeds beter toe te passen in hun dagelijkse werk. De exacte onderzoeksopdracht bepalen we samen, zodat deze aansluit bij jouw opleiding, interesses en afstudeereisen. HG is een compacte, snelgroeiende en internationale organisatie waar je direct de impact van je werk ziet. Dit vraagt om eigenaarschap, initiatief en een pragmatische, resultaatgerichte houding. De cultuur is open en stimuleert het delen van ideeën, constructieve samenwerking en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Alles wat we doen is gebaseerd op onze kernwaarden: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected. Wat ga je doen? Binnen HG zijn de eerste stappen in AI-adoptie al gezet. Er is dus een fundament om op voort te bouwen. Tijdens jouw stage help je ons om naar brede, structurele adoptie te gaan. Concreet ga je onder andere: Praktische en inspirerende Copilot-demo’s geven aan verschillende groepen medewerkers. Bestaande adoptiedata analyseren en vertalen naar inzichten en concrete acties om gebruik en impact te vergroten. Onderzoeken waar adoptie achterblijft en welke interventies kunnen helpen om medewerkers verder te brengen. AI-trainingsprogramma’s ontwerpen en uitvoeren voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus, van collega’s die net beginnen tot ervaren gebruikers. Trainingen, workshops, oefeningen en praktische hulpmiddelen ontwikkelen waarmee medewerkers AI direct in hun eigen werk kunnen toepassen. De Copilot Academy op ons intranet verder ontwikkelen en actueel en relevant houden. Medewerkers meenemen in de bredere AI-transformatie en concreet maken wat AI voor hun eigen werkzaamheden betekent. Het AI Champions-programma ondersteunen en verder helpen ontwikkelen. Feedback en behoeften van medewerkers ophalen en vertalen naar verbeteringen in trainingen, communicatie en andere adoptie-initiatieven. Onderzoeken welke activiteiten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan meer gebruik, betere AI-vaardigheden en waarde voor de organisatie. Jouw onderzoek en werkzaamheden helpen HG om AI niet alleen beschikbaar te maken, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van de dagelijkse manier van werken. Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met onze AI Transformation Lead en hebt veel contact met collega’s uit verschillende afdelingen binnen de organisatie. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van zowel de menselijke als bedrijfskundige kant van AI-transformatie. Omdat HG actief is in meer dan 45 landen, werk je bovendien in een internationale omgeving waarin verschillende functies, perspectieven en niveaus van AI-volwassenheid samenkomen. “We beginnen bij HG niet meer vanaf nul met AI. Er ligt een fundament en steeds meer collega’s werken ermee. De interessante vraag is nu: hoe zorgen we dat AI voor veel meer mensen écht onderdeel wordt van hun dagelijkse werk? Ik zoek iemand die het leuk vindt om daar samen met mij de volgende stap in te zetten.” – Els Marchal,

jobs.title: Senior Projectmanager
jobs.description: Jouw Missie bij CCS Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam. Voordelen voor de sollicitant Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? Een voorbeeld van je werkdag Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant. Wie jij bent De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten: · Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten; · Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope; · Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat; · Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig; · Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift; · Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch; · Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties; · Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.
