jobs.title: Vertriebsmitarbeiter B2C (m/w/d) im Innendienst
jobs.description: Wir versüßen Ihr Leben…! Diese Leidenschaft leben wir seit 1907. Seitdem haben wir uns mit viel Herz und Engagement zu einem der führenden Confiserie-Unternehmen in Deutschland entwickelt. In 2025 haben wir die Marke Leysieffer erfolgreich in unser Unternehmen aufgenommen. Wir stellen eine große Bandbreite hochwertiger Confiserie-Spezialitäten her. So sind wir gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden zum Marktführer für handwerklich hergestellte Macarons, Baumkuchen, Dominosteine und schokoladenüberzogene Torten gewachsen. Unser Familienunternehmen wird in vierter Generation vom Inhaber Christian Rabbel geführt. Unsere über 150 Konditoren und Fachkräfte beweisen jeden Tag aufs Neue ihr handwerkliches Können mit viel Liebe zum Produkt und Ideenreichtum für unsere Kunden. Alle Produkte und Verpackungen sind echte Handarbeit -made in Germany- und werden im eigenen Haus entwickelt und designt. Daher sind Rabbel-Produkte für unsere Kunden individuell und einzigartig. Mit unserem Reinheitsgebot versprechen wir unseren Kunden allerbeste Rohstoffe und den Verzicht auf Konservierungsstoffe oder andere nicht natürliche Zusätze. Unsere Umwelt ist uns sehr wichtig. The internet has always been abused by bad actors, and AI is making it exponentially worse, driving fraud, abuse, and manipulation at a scale and speed no human team can fight alone. Cinder gives platforms one command center to fight back: to write and enforce policy, deploy AI agents against abuse in real time, investigate threats, file NCMEC reports, and prove their safety programs are working. For some customers, "close" means embedded. You're effectively part of their engineering team, in their Slack, on their calls, building alongside them. The platforms you'd be embedded with have hundreds of millions of users between them. When you fix something, it's not hypothetical. It's live, that day. Turn fieldwork into product leverage. Solve issues in the systems you ship, identify patterns across customers, and turn those lessons into reusable tools and improvements to the core product. Own on-call for customers when system downtime means moderation stops. What we're looking for 4-8 years as a software engineer, solutions engineer, or in a similar role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Solid Python fundamentals. You can read, debug, and extend backend code without hand-holding. Comfortability with SQL, Typescript, React, and GraphQL. Real experience owning implementation, not just scoping it. You are exceptionally comfortable with ambiguity and repeatedly take initiative — you thrive when dropped into unfamiliar situations, learning quickly, and finding ways to deliver value. No degree requirement. We care about what you can build, not where you learned to build it. Bootcamp grads are welcome. Experience being embedded with a customer or client team, rather than working at arm's length through tickets. We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments. We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software. As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. About the Role As an Engineering Manager, you lead a team building and operating core parts of Radiant's cloud platform. You combine people leadership, technical judgement, delivery ownership and cross-functional collaboration. You work closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, security and other engineering teams. What You'll Do As an Engineering Manager – AI, you will lead a team building and operating the platforms customers use to train and serve AI models on our GPU infrastructure, joining one of our AI teams: MLOps Training or MLOps Inference. jobs.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: About HappyRobot HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $150M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide. Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Application Security Engineer to help secure our product and platform through hands-on security architecture and engineering. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and compliance teams, taking ownership from identifying risks through designing, implementing, and rolling out solutions. We’re a lean security team, so your work will span security reviews, vulnerability management, platform hardening, automation, incident response, and compliance engineering. Alongside finding and fixing vulnerabilities, you’ll identify opportunities to prevent entire classes of risks through shared security controls and centralized enforcement. You’ll help decide where these investments matter most and build solutions that teams can adopt as the company grows. jobs.title: Post-doctorant(e) en IA agentique correcte par construction (SoS)  - CDD de 12 mois
jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en IA agentique correcte par construction (SoS) pour rejoindre le département INFRES de Télécom Paris. Contexte scientifique : les cadres de vérification existants supposent généralement des modèles finis et précisément définis, dont les actions et les relations de transition sont connues. Ces hypothèses sont difficiles à maintenir dans les systèmes modernes d’IA agentique, où les actions peuvent être générées dynamiquement, les environnements peuvent évoluer et les informations sur le système peuvent être incomplètes. Le projet Sound or Silent (SoS) vise à combler cette lacune en étudiant une nouvelle approche d’IA agentique correcte par construction. L’idée centrale consiste à intégrer le raisonnement stratégique et la vérification formelle directement au processus décisionnel des agents autonomes. Au lieu de vérifier un agent uniquement après son développement ou de surveiller son comportement après l’exécution, SoS étudie la possibilité de produire des actions formellement certifiées conformes à une spécification donnée. Selon cette approche, une action candidate n’est exécutée que s’il est établi qu’elle appartient à une stratégie garantissant les propriétés requises. Si une telle garantie ne peut être établie, l’agent s’abstient d’agir. Atteindre cet objectif exige d’étendre les techniques de vérification stratégique à des environnements ouverts, évolutifs et partiellement spécifiés, et d’étudier des notions de correction adaptées à une information incomplète. Le projet explorera également une architecture associant un composant génératif non fiable, chargé de proposer des actions ou des stratégies candidates, à un noyau de vérification formelle de confiance, chargé d’en contrôler la correction. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’expressivité des modèles formels sous-jacents, au coût de calcul de la certification et au compromis entre garanties formelles et capacité des agents à accomplir des tâches utiles. Les travaux associeront des développements théoriques à la réalisation et à l’évaluation expérimentale de prototypes, dans des scénarios de planification autonome, d’agents d’IA utilisant des outils et de coordination multi-agents. L’objectif général est de poser les fondements de systèmes d’IA agentique dont l’autonomie est encadrée par des garanties stratégiques formellement vérifiables. Vos missions principales seront de : Mener des travaux de recherche sur l’IA agentique correcte par construction Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat Contribuer au rayonnement scientifique de Télécom Paris Vous devrez être titulaire d’un doctorat ou d’un diplôme équivalent et disposer de solides connaissances en méthodes formelles, logique et vérification de modèles. Une expérience dans les systèmes multi-agents, les logiques stratégiques, la vérification à l’exécution ainsi que dans le développement d’agents fondés sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM) sera également attendue. Vous devrez maîtriser le développement logiciel et l’implémentation d’algorithmes, ainsi que la démarche de recherche scientifique, notamment la formulation de problématiques, la conception d’expériences et l’analyse de leurs résultats. Une excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, sera indispensable. Enfin, vous devrez faire preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe, de qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles ainsi que d’un esprit de synthèse. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Vous travaillerez dans un enviro

jobs.description: ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient. Ce poste, ouvert au sein d’IMT Mines Albi, est rattaché au Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) qui compte à ce jour environ 70 personnes. Le centre s’intéresse à la cinétique des organisations et au développement de solutions d’aide à la décision dans des contextes hétérogènes, collaboratifs et incertains. Ceci est mis en pratique par la représentation, la modélisation et l’analyse des données de ces organisations afin de formaliser de la connaissance conduisant à la prise de décision dans des contextes hétérogènes, collaboratifs, incertains et/ou perturbés. Le CGI est structuré selon quatre axes de recherche appliquée : Axe FLOWS : Systèmes logistiques flexibles pour un monde durable ; Axe DISCS : Systèmes numériques pour la gestion des crises et la sécurité ; Axe WHOPS : Systèmes organisationnels pour la santé et le bien-être ; Axe TRACE : Résilience territoriale, agilité et économie circulaire. Huit expertises scientifiques et techniques sont au cœur de ces axes de recherche : Ingénierie systèmes, Ingénierie des modèles, Théorie de la décision, Recherche opérationnelle, Technologies immersives, IA générative, IA symbolique, et IA connexionniste. Les chercheurs et ingénieurs du CGI exploitent et contribuent particulièrement aux paradigmes scientifiques suivants pour réaliser les projets de recherche ou formation : l’Internet Physique, la Physique des Décisions, les Jumeaux Numériques Organisationnels. Le poste à pourvoir concerne l'un des projets de recherche de l'axe WHOPS. Le but de ce projet est de répondre à un besoin exprimé par l'Agence Régionale de Santé (ARS) et un hôpital de la région parisienne. La personne recrutée sera intégrée à une équipe de chercheurs en ingénierie organisationnelle pour la santé, ce qui garantira un accompagnement visant une montée en régime rapide et un suivi régulier des activités de l'ingénieur(e) recruté(e).   DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : Le contexte général du projet concerne le pilotage des capacités hospitalières et l'anticipation des tensions sur l'offre de soins. Il s'agit d'un enjeu majeur pour les établissements de santé, les institutions en charge de la planification de l'offre de soins, et plus largement, pour l'ensemble des professionnels impliqués dans l'orientation des patients. L'objectif général du projet est de développer et expérimenter, en s'appuyant sur des données réelles provenant du système d'information d'un hôpital, des outils innovants d'analyse et de prévision-prédiction de l'activité hospitalière, essentiels pour améliorer l'anticipation et le pilotage des capacités (ressources humaines et lits). Parmi les outils et solutions envisagés, un intérêt particulier porte sur les principes du jumeau numérique asynchrone permettant l'analyse rétrospective des parcours patients et la simulation "in silico" de scénarios prospectifs. jobs.title: DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer - Internship
jobs.description: About Bitstack It all started with an idea in 2021. Initially built to democratize Bitcoin in France, Bitstack has gone from a simple product that invests spare change in bitcoin, to a crypto-native bank bringing a better way to save, spend, and grow money to our 300K+ users. We want to rebuild finance from the ground up to empower people to achieve financial freedom by participating in a more open and inclusive financial system. We’re a small, ambitious team of operators. We believe in moving fast, sweating the details, and creating products people truly love. At Bitstack, you’ll have the opportunity to shape not just our products, but the culture and practices of our entire organization. Bitstack is backed by YC, leading VCs like 13books Capital, Stillmark, Serena, and many more. We are building a product our users love and we are just getting started! The Role Bitstack runs dozens of interconnected backend services on Google Cloud. As the engineering team grows, we want every engineer to be able to test their changes end to end, quickly and independently, before they reach our shared environments. As part of the Infrastructure team, you will build a local test environment for our backend engineers and QA. The goal is simple: anyone can start our backend services and their dependencies on their own machine with a single command, reproduce real business scenarios and test asynchronous flows end to end. You will own the project from the initial assessment through to company-wide adoption. What You'll Be Doing 1. Assessment & Recommendation Learn our stack (Go and Python services, Bazel, Docker, Kubernetes, GCP) and map how our services depend on each other. Evaluate the test tooling and emulators already in our codebase, as well as the tools available on the market. Recommend an approach, and record your tooling choices and trade-offs in a decision log. 2. Building the Local Environment Start with a pilot cluster of interconnected services and get it running locally with a single command. Solve the real problems as they come up: configuration and secrets, service-to-service authentication, cloud dependencies (Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, databases, caches) and async workers. Extend coverage cluster by cluster until every backend service is included. 3. Scenarios, Data & Adoption Build seed data and scripts so that any user state, limit or time-based event can be reproduced and reset on demand. Work with backend engineers and QA as your first users, gather their feedback and fix what breaks. Write documentation clear enough for a new engineer to get set up on their own, and support the team through the switchover. By the end of the internship, you will turn your decision log into a recommendation report and hand over a tool the team will keep maintaining. You will gain hands-on experience with a production-grade microservices architecture on Google Cloud, and see how a platform tool is designed, built and adopted by an engineering team. You will learn how infrastructure decisions are made and documented, and work closely with backend, QA and infrastructure engineers, with mentoring from a DevOps engineer throughout. What We're Looking For Currently in the final year of an engineering school or Master’s degree (Bac+5) in Computer Science or a related field, and looking for a 6-month end-of-studies internship starting in early 2027. Hands-on experience with Docker and a working knowledge of Kubernetes. Comfortable with Linux and scripting (shell, Python or similar). Previous experience with a cloud provider, through an internship, a project or coursework. GCP is a plus. Experience with Go, Bazel or Docker Compose is a plus, but not required. Curious and autonomous: you like to understand how a system fits together before changing it. Able to explain technical trade-offs clearly, in writing and to the engineers who will use what you build. Fluent in English. French is a plus. Based in Paris or happy to relocate for the internship

The Role Bitstack is a crypto-asset service provider authorised under the MiCA Regulation. As such, we are subject to strict requirements relating to anti-money laundering (AML), counter-terrorist financing (CTF) and fraud prevention. As part of the Compliance team, you will contribute to the day-to-day implementation of our compliance framework. You will review alerts and customer cases across three key areas: transaction monitoring, screening and KYC. What You'll Be Doing 1. Transaction Monitoring (Fiat & Crypto) Analyse and investigate transaction monitoring alerts across euro payment flows (card payments and SEPA transfers) and crypto flows (on-chain deposits and withdrawals). Examine transaction patterns, counterparties and wallet exposure to assess each alert and determine whether it is a false positive or should be escalated. Detect fraudulent activity, including payment fraud, account takeovers and scams targeting our users. Document your findings and, where appropriate, prepare the supporting information for a suspicious activity report to TRACFIN, the French financial intelligence unit. Contribute to improving detection scenarios and monitoring alert metrics. 2. You will also contribute to updating internal procedures and monitoring emerging fraud and money laundering typologies within the crypto ecosystem. jobs.title: Stage Assistant - Analyste éthique et positionnement (H/F/X) - Paris
jobs.description: Nous recherchons un.e stagiaire Assistant.e – Analyste éthique et positionnement (financements institutionnels et partenariats avec le secteur privé) / basé.e à Paris. Le stage se déroulera au sein de l'Institut Humanitaire de Handicap International, dans une équipe de 3 personnes : -        Une directrice de l’Institut -        Deux analystes éthiques et positionnement, chacun.e référent.e, respectivement, pour : Les partenariats opérationnels Les financements institutionnels les partenariats avec le secteur privé L’Institut a pour rôle de : Fournir en interne des éléments d’analyse, de conseil et d’accompagnement concernant les enjeux éthiques et de positionnement d’HI ; Contribuer au rayonnement et à l’influence d’HI pour les enjeux de solidarité internationale. La mission principale du stage est de venir en appui à l’équipe de l’Institut sur ses projets de recherche et d’analyse sur des sujets liés à l’actualité géopolitique, ainsi qu’à l’éthique des financements institutionnels et des partenariats avec le secteur privé. Le stage vise à développer une capacité d’analyse critique et de raisonnement éthique appliqué : comprendre les tensions entre principes et réalités opérationnelles, identifier les risques et les dilemmes et contribuer à l’élaboration de recommandations utiles à la décision. Dans ce cadre, les missions qui vous seront confiées sont les suivantes: Activité 1 – Analyser les enjeux éthiques des partenariats avec le secteur privé -        Réaliser des recherches approfondies sur les activités, les pratiques, les engagements et les controverses associés aux entités concernées. -        Identifier et analyser les arguments en faveur ou en défaveur d’un partenariat en fonction de sa compatibilité avec les valeurs, principes humanitaires et engagements de HI. -        Effectuer un suivi de l’évolution du droit de la Responsabilité Sociétale des Entreprises (RSE) et des pratiques des entités du secteur privé opérant dans des secteurs à risque. Activité 2 – Analyser les enjeux éthiques des financements institutionnels -        Réalise des recherches documentaires et des analyses sur les stratégies, priorités et mécanismes de financement des bailleurs institutionnels. -        Identifier les dilemmes et risques éthiques susceptibles de découler de l’acceptation d’un financement, notamment au regard des principes humanitaires. -        Participer à la formulation d’avis argumentés et de points de vigilance permettant d’éclairer les décisions de l’organisation. Activité 3 – Contribuer à la formation interne et aux relations externes de l’Institut -        Participer à la préparation et à l’animation de séquences de formation et à la présentation de travaux de l’Institut auprès des équipes internes. Contribuer au développement des échanges avec des acteurs externes. Requirements Profil recherché: Vous êtes issu d'une formation Master en en Action Humanitaire/Développement, Relations Internationales ou Droit International, ou toute autre formation permettant de mobiliser des connaissances en géopolitique et en droit international, avec un intérêt particulier pour les enjeux humanitaires, les enjeux opérationnels en zone d'urgence et l’éthique. Vous êtes familier avec le milieu de la solidarité internationale (ONGI, UN, association nationale/locale…); Une expérience préalable à l’étranger et l’engagement dans le milieu associatif sont valorisés Analyse, recherche et rédaction -        Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles en français et en anglais. -        Capacité à conduire une recherche documentaire approfondie

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent. The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current. Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms. The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns. The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team. Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built. How we work We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here. We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard. Your first year In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival. By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team. Who we are looking for You have shipped and run product

Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling. Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners. Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements. What We're Looking For 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production. Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems. Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs. Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain. Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Evals
jobs.description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. About the team Join the AI team at Prosus, a global technology group with businesses in food delivery, e-commerce, classifieds, travel and payments. We build LCM, the Large Commerce Model: our own foundation model, trained on billions of transactions and interactions from proprietary data across the portfolio. LCM already powers search, recommendations and marketing in production at iFood. We are extending it across our companies around the world and to businesses outside the group, while broadening its capabilities in agents and real-time prediction tasks. Your work will shape what LCM learns next and feed directly into products used by millions of people. About the role Evaluation is the core of everything we do. We build from the evals: we define how success will be measured before developing a capability, and use the results to guide training, model selection and deployment. We already have hundreds of evaluations spanning domain knowledge, commerce and gaming, with plans to expand their coverage, depth and scale. This work builds on ProLLM, the public benchmarking platform we ran for real-world use cases until our coding assistant benchmarks became saturated. Since then it has been a private benchmarking platform for Prosus companies. We plan to open it again to publish our commerce benchmarks, covering both agentic and decision-making tasks. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to own the development of these evaluations and the platform that runs them. The work involves defining meaningful tasks, curating evaluation data, implementing reliable scoring, investigating model behaviour and making results useful for research and product decisions. In our flat team of around 30 engineers, you’ll work directly with applied scientists, training engineers and domain experts. You’ll help teams contribute evaluations and build the infrastructure and automation needed to run them throughout model development. In the first three months, we expect you to take technical ownership of part of the evaluation platform, deliver a set of new or improved evaluations with curated data and calibrated difficulty, and work with scientists to use them in a training or release decision. What the role involves Design evaluations with scientists and domain experts, translating intended capabilities into representative tasks, datasets and success criteria. Cover current applications and capabilities we want future models to acquire. Curate evaluation data and calibrate task difficulty, so that evaluations are neither saturated nor out of reach and still separate models of different quality. Work with domain experts on sourcing, annotation and review, within data provenance, permitted use across companies and privacy requirements. Own the development and operation of the evaluation platform across training checkpoints, deployed mode

jobs.title: Stage Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
jobs.description: Wil jij ervaren hoe het is om AI niet alleen technisch te begrijpen, maar ook écht werkend te maken binnen een organisatie? Heb jij interesse in AI, data, technologie én consultancy? Dan is deze stage binnen ons Data & AI-team misschien wel jouw volgende stap! Vanaf februari 2027 zoeken wij een stagiair(e) Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Data Science die gedurende 3 tot 12 maanden meewerkt aan interne AI-initiatieven binnen IG&H. Met deze stage krijg je de kans om jouw technische vaardigheden te combineren met consultancyvaardigheden: van het bouwen of onderzoeken van AI-oplossingen tot het ophalen van behoeften bij stakeholders en het ondersteunen van AI-adoptie binnen onze organisatie. Wat ga je doen? Tijdens deze leerzame stage ga je aan de slag met interne AI-oplossingen en innovatieprojecten. Afhankelijk van de behoefte vanuit de business werk je zelfstandig aan projecten binnen het team. Je kunt bijvoorbeeld bijdragen aan: het ontwikkelen of verbeteren van AI-tools die interne processen efficiënter maken; het in kaart brengen van processen binnen interne teams en onderzoeken waar AI kan helpen/ondersteunen; het ondersteunen van AI-adoptie binnen IG&H, bijvoorbeeld door mee te denken over trainingen, communicatie of praktische toepassingen van tools zoals Copilot; het doen van onderzoek naar nieuwe AI-producten, toepassingen of proposities; het vertalen van technische mogelijkheden naar concrete businesswaarde; samenwerken met andere collega’s binnen Data & AI. Over het team Wij helpen onze klanten innoveren en gebruikmaken van de nieuwste data- en AI-technologie. Samen realiseren zij innovatieve data-, analytics- en AI-oplossingen voor klanten in Retail, Financial Services en Health. Het team groeit snel en heeft de ambitie om verder uit te bouwen tot een van de meest toonaangevende Data & AI-praktijken van Nederland. Die groei komt voort uit ons succes: klanten kiezen steeds vaker voor IG&H vanwege onze combinatie van strategisch inzicht, technische expertise en pragmatische executie. We werken aan projecten die direct bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming, efficiëntere processen en nieuwe businessmodellen. Voor professionals die impact willen maken is dit een omgeving waar ondernemerschap, innovatie en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. Hier bouw je niet alleen mee aan de toekomst van onze klanten, maar ook aan de verdere groei van het Data & AI-team zelf. Ervaring met SQL, API’s, Azure of AI-tools zoals Copilot is mooi meegenomen, maar geen harde eis. Belangrijker vinden we dat je nieuwsgierig bent, snel leert en zin hebt om jezelf inhoudelijk te ontwikkelen. jobs.title: Private Equity Sales Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Als innovativer sowie dynamischer Dienstleister im Zukunftsmarkt Gesundheit strebt die Health Rise AG mit ihrem Gesundheitsportal nebst integriertem Online-Shop kontinuierlich danach, Menschen immer einfacher ein gesundes Leben zu ermöglichen. Stetiges Wachstum und die Förderung der Markenbekanntheit sind daraus abgeleitete Ziele. Um diese Ambitionen sowie das intensive Wachstum des Unternehmens weiter voranzutreiben, suchen wir einen kommunikationsstarken Private Equity Sales Manager. Sie haben bereits einschlägige Erfahrungen in der Kommunikation mit Aktionären gesammelt und können sich für die Themen von Health Rise begeistern? Dann machen Sie den nächsten Schritt bei der Health Rise AG als wegweisendem Unternehmen mit großen Möglichkeiten. Gefragt sind Sie als vertriebsstarker Kommunikator, um die Health Rise AG mit einem rundum gesunden Marktplatz-Angebot schneller etablieren und ausbauen zu können. Werden Sie ein wegweisender Gestalter im Team. Ihr Engagement zahlt sich aus: Mit besonders attraktiven Provisionen partizipieren Sie als Spitzenverdiener direkt am Erfolg. Werden Sie Teil der Erfolgsgeschichte als erfahrener sowie motivierter Private Equity Sales Manager (m/w/d) . Aufgaben Eigenständige Identifizierung und Gewinnung von potenziellen neuen Investoren, deren Profil zum Unternehmen passt. Direkte Ansprache von potenziellen Investoren und Aktionären per Telefon, E-Mail und persönlichen Meetings. Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Beziehungen zu bestehenden und potenziellen Investoren. Führen von Verhandlungen mit potenziellen Investoren und Partnern über Konditionen, Beteiligungen und Kapitalstruktur. Unterstützung bei der Vertragsgestaltung und Koordination der finalen Investmentprozesse. Verantwortung für eine aufgeschlossene, proaktive sowie intensive Investorenkommunikation und der Pflege relevanter Netzwerke. Regelmäßige Kommunikation über die Unternehmensentwicklung, Finanzkennzahlen und Meilensteine, um das Vertrauen der Investoren zu stärken. Umsetzung neuer und innovativer Maßnahmen, um potenzielle Investoren besser zu adressieren und die Erfolgschancen des Unternehmens zu erhöhen. Zusammenarbeit mit dem Managementteam bei der Planung und Durchführung von Finanzierungsrunden. Regelmäßiger Austausch zur Wirksamkeit der Investorengewinnungsmaßnahmen mit dem Management. Qualifikation Erfahrung im Bereich von vorbörslichen Investments oder im Vertrieb von Finanzdienstleistungen. Exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Informationen klar und überzeugend zu präsentieren. Überzeugungsstark im Dialog mit Kapitalmarktteilnehmern sowie idealerweise auch effektive Abschlussqualitäten. Gutes Beziehungsmanagement und starke Netzwerkfähigkeiten. Verhandlungsgeschick und Erfahrung beim Abschluss von Investmentverträgen. Analytische Fähigkeiten und grundlegende Finanzkenntnisse, um das Unternehmenswachstum überzeugend darstellen zu können. Fachkenntnisse in den Bereichen Kapitalmärkte, Börsen, Unternehmensfinanzierung und Finanzberichterstattung. Eigenständige Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative, Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität. Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift. Benefits Die Möglichkeit, eigenständig und eigenverantwortlich zu arbeiten. Attraktives Provisionsmodell mit exzellenten Verdienstmöglichkeiten und deutlich sechsstelligem Zieleinkommen. Spannende und verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben, ein kreatives Umfeld und flache Hierarchien. Einen umfassenden Handlungsspielraum zur Umsetzung kreativer Vorgehensmodelle und Ideen. Ein ambitioniertes sowie multikulturelles Team, das inspiriert und unterstützt. Gute Erreichbarkeit mit dem PKW und öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Home-Office-Option. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: LIMS-Projektmitarbeiter (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Gestalte die Zukunft mit uns - werde Teil des Teams bei viridiusLAB AG! 🌿 viridiusLab AG ist ein Prüflabor-Unternehmen mit mehr als 900 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den zentraleuropäischen Markt der Prüflabore neu zu definieren und investieren im Bereich Umwelt-, Lebensmittel- und Pharmaanalytik sowie im Bereich der Material- und Werkstoffprüfung. Du unterstützt aktiv unsere Beteiligungen bei der Einführung der gruppenweiten LIMS-Lösung. Dein Fokus liegt darauf, die bestehenden Prozesse aufzunehmen, in das neue System zu überführen und die Mitarbeitenden aktiv zu begleiten . Du verstehst Laborprozesse und kannst sie in digitale Systeme übersetzen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Aufgaben Prozessaufnahme & Umsetzung : Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe in den Laboren und Geschäftsbereichen und übersetzt sie in die neue Systemlandschaft Mitarbeiterbegleitung & Schulung : Du unterstützt die Teams bei der Umstellung auf das neue System, vermittelst Wissen praxisnah und stehst als Ansprechpartner zur Verfügung Datenvalidierung & Migration : Du sorgst für eine saubere Stimme der Kunden: Du gibst die Stimme unserer Kunden weiter – sammelst ihr Feedback, ihre Anregungen und Kritik und leitest sie an die richtigen Stellen weiter, um unseren Service und unser Produkt kontinuierlich zu verbessern. jobs.title: Web Designer Intern (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Most of the internet looks the same now. Help us make sure our corner of it doesn't. Cloud Studios is a product studio in Berlin. We build our own products and grow the strongest into companies. Our whole idea fits in one line: build what should exist . We're looking for a Web Designer Intern to own how our websites look, feel and work. Ours, and our clients'. What you'll work on A wide range of work, across several brands at once: Our own sites. The Cloud Studios and GetMOW websites are live, and they're never finished. You'll redesign pages, sharpen what's there and add what's missing. Launches. We have new products in the pipeline. When one is ready to meet the world, you'll design the site it meets the world on, often starting from a blank page. Client websites. We also design and build websites for clients. You'll take projects from first idea to live site, and help present them. The details nobody asked for. Motion, interactions, the 404 page, what happens when you hover. That's where a website stops looking like everyone else's. By the end of your internship, you'll have several live websites with your name on them. Ownership, for real You won't be pushing pixels on someone else's mockup. You'll get a brief, sometimes just a problem, and the freedom to answer it your way. You'll work directly with Eli, our founder, from the first idea to launch day, and see your work go live in weeks, not quarters. That freedom comes with responsibility. If you think a page is wrong, say so and redesign it. Nobody here will ask you to stay in your lane. About AI Anyone can generate a website now. That's the problem. The internet is filling up with sites that look like they all came from the same prompt, and we're not hiring someone to make more of them. We use AI every day, and we'd love it if you do too: to explore faster, prototype faster and build things you couldn't build alone. But the idea has to be yours. Your taste, your references, your weirdness. We want work that nobody could copy by typing the same prompt. If something in your portfolio has made someone ask "how did you do that?", we want to see it. Who you are You've designed websites before, and you can show us. Client work, a side project, your own portfolio, a site for your friend's band: live sites count for more than concepts. You have opinions about type, layout and motion. You notice when something is a few pixels off, and it bothers you. You'd rather make something strange that works than something safe that nobody remembers. You'll need: Experience designing websites, and a portfolio that proves it. Strong skills in Figma or a similar design tool. A real eye for typography, layout and motion. Good English, written and spoken. To work independently. You'll manage your own time and projects, whether you're at home or in the office. Bonus points: You can turn a design into a simple live page with a no-code tool like Framer or Webflow, or with a little HTML and CSS. Nice to have, not a must: you won't be writing production code here. You've designed or built with AI before, and you have an opinion on where it helps and where it doesn't. There's something in your portfolio you made purely because you wanted it to exist. German. A design role, not a development role To be clear about what this is: this internship is about visual and interaction design . You'll spend your time on concepts, layouts, typography, motion and design systems, mostly in Figma. Development is handled separately. If you're mainly a frontend developer who designs a bit on the side, this probably isn't the right fit. If you're a designer who can't stop thinking about how a site looks, feels and moves, it is. What you get Ownership early. Real websites, real clients and real launches, from your first week. Creative freedom. We give you problems, not pixel specs. A portfolio that's actually live. jobs.title: Growth Associate
jobs.description: About us Every large industrial company is trying to make better decisions with the data it already owns. Most hit the same wall. Strategy lives in one system, sales in another, the market model in a consultant's spreadsheet, and the plan in a deck nobody has opened since the offsite. By the time a regional head knows a segment has moved, the quarter is gone. The data exists. It just never arrives anywhere a decision is being made. STRATOS was built to solve this problem. We work with global B2B companies to synchronize strategy and execution and ensure commercial success is driven by potential, not gut feel or old data. STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup, profitable and majority founder-owned with our Series A still ahead of us, funded by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by 15 global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI. The role You own how we reach the commercial leaders at Europe’s largest manufacturers, and whether they reply. You plan and run the campaigns, make the calls, write the sequences, build the materials that get someone into a room, and keep the pipeline numbers our CRO takes to the board. You do all of it with AI tooling that lets one person cover what used to take a team, and you work directly with the CEO, CRO and CMO on what to try next. Tasks Run campaigns end to end. Plan, launch, and optimise outreach campaigns. Write, test, measure, iterate. Own outbound. Run cold calling, email sequences, and LinkedIn programmes targeting commercial leaders at Europe’s largest manufacturers, armed with the AI-recommended warm intro paths and account intelligence. Drive our paid channels. Organise, launch, and optimise paid campaigns, from targeting and creative through to spend decisions and attribution. Build materials that win meetings. Produce client documents, demos, and interactive presentations from our library of high-end content, using our templates and AI tooling. Fast turnaround, senior-team standard. Keep the engine clean. Log your activity, keep pipeline data spotless in HubSpot, and produce the weekly pipeline, coverage, and forecast numbers the CRO uses to manage the number and brief the board. Make our commercial engine sharper every week. New plays, new automations, new content for the library. What you build compounds. Use AI as a force multiplier. We are an AI-first company. You will use our AI tooling and automations to do the work of a team several times your size. Who this is for Most people who do well here have one to three years behind them in growth, sales development or commercial execution at a B2B software company, or a strategy background and a clear preference for doing the work over advising on it. You have run outreach yourself and can tell us the numbers: how many you sent, what came back, and what you changed when it didn’t work. You write well under constraint. Most of this job is persuading a busy executive in four sentences, and you know the difference between a cold email that lands and one that gets deleted unread. You reach for automation before you reach for repetition. HubSpot, Sales Navigator, sequencing tools and modern AI tooling are things you have used already, or will teach yourself over a weekend. You measure yourself on meetings booked and pipeline created. You are comfortable hearing that your campaign didn’t work, and quick to change it. This probably isn’t for you if you want a defined remit, a marketing role one step removed from the phone, or a job where someone else owns the number. What we offer Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company A highly competitive salary Direct access to Fortune 500 executives from your first months, at a level most people wait a decade for Work alongside former MBB consultan

jobs.title: Tech Lead - Terminals
jobs.description: About Ryft Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms. We enable marketplaces, SaaS platforms and multi-party ecosystems to embed and monetise payments natively. Our technology handles onboarding, compliance, orchestration, split payments and revenue sharing, allowing our partners to focus on growth while we manage complexity. We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform. About the Job Are you an engineering leader who wants to own the systems that connect physical point-of-sale hardware to a modern, scalable payments platform? We are looking for a Tech Lead to head up our Card Present (In-Person Payments) squad. You will lead the technical direction and hands-on delivery of the infrastructure that allows our merchants to take physical payments. You'll work across our C#/.NET backend on AWS, shaping how physical card taps and inserts securely communicate with our event-driven services, split funds, and settle correctly. This is a hands-on, high-impact leadership role. You won't just be managing a Jira board, you'll be deep in the architecture, writing code, mentoring your squad, and owning the technical strategy for our physical terminal estate. You will bridge the gap between cloud infrastructure and physical hardware, ensuring our in-person payment flows are as robust, scalable, and developer-friendly as our online ones. What You'll Work On In-person payments architecture: Leading the technical design for our card-present estate, ensuring low-latency, highly reliable communication between physical terminals and our AWS backend. Terminal & Gateway Integration: Building the critical paths that connect smart payment terminals and Point of Sale (POS) systems into Ryft’s core gateway and marketplace routing logic. Hardware-to-cloud flows: Handling the unique complexities of physical payments: offline modes, state synchronization, hardware webhooks, and complex failure modes. Security & Compliance pipelines: Ensuring our physical payment flows remain airtight and fully compliant within heavily regulated environments. Squad Leadership: Setting the technical standard for the Card Present squad. Breaking down complex product requirements into actionable architecture and guiding engineers through delivery. The platform itself: Contributing to our broader event-driven C#/.NET service estate, infrastructure-as-code, and observability tooling alongside other Tech Leads. Responsibilities Lead technical delivery: Architect, build, and ship end-to-end features for our card-present offering. You are the ultimate technical owner of what your squad ships. Design for hardware-cloud correctness: Write and architect services that behave under network drops, partial failure, and hardware concurrency. Idempotency and absolute accuracy are the job, not edge cases. Raise the bar & mentor: Improve the codebase and our engineering practices. Review code rigorously, set conventions, and level up the engineers in your squad. Own it in production: Take real ownership of what goes live: instrumentation, alerting, and incident response for a system where physical merchants are relying on your uptime to make a living. Harness AI, stay in control: Use AI-assisted workflows to multiply your output (we invest heavily in them) while remaining in full command of every line you ship and review. Collaborate: Work day-to-day with your Engineering Manager, Product Managers, hardware vendors, and other squads to deliver seamless omnichannel payment features. Experience & Skills Required Technical Leadership: Proven experience leading technical projects, architecting complex backend systems, and guiding small teams of engineers to deliver high-quality software. Strong backend engineering: Significant commercial experience building and running production backend services.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Data)
jobs.description: About Codat Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work. Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time. The Role Some of the biggest commercial banks in the world already work with us. Their relationship managers want to spend their time with clients, not digging through the books to find out what's changed. We're building the thing that does the digging for them. It's called the Advisory Intelligence Platform. It puts Codat's client intelligence inside the assistant a banker already uses, starting with Microsoft Copilot. Ask it anything about a client and it answers from that client's actual books. Don't ask, and it tells you anyway when something important changes. Every one of those answers sits on data. Someone has to get that data in, shape it, define it and serve it, so the number the assistant quotes is the right one. That's you. You write production software, and you care about the data it moves as much as the code that moves it. This role is for an engineer who's growing fast and wants room to grow faster. You'll ship from your first weeks, own what you build once it's live, and work alongside data and AI engineers who'll push you. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS, and we work that way ourselves: agents take the repetitive work, engineers take the interesting problems. What You'll Work On The data behind every answer. Services and pipelines that take raw data from accounting platforms, banks and payment systems and turn it into something a model can trust. When a source sends rubbish, your code notices. The semantic layer. The definitions the model is allowed to use: what counts as revenue, when a month ends, which currency. Get it right and every answer agrees with every other answer. The signal layer. Spotting when something changes for a client: a customer paying later, cash running tighter, a supplier quietly becoming critical. You'll help build the detection and make it fast and reliable. The tools the assistant calls. MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and APIs that serve data to agents. You'll build them, test them and find out how they break before a banker does. Keeping the numbers honest. Tests, data checks and observability that prove a number is right, and catch it the moment it isn't. You'll Probably Have Shipped production software that real people depended on, and written most of it yourself. Services, APIs or data systems with tests, not notebooks or config. Had data be the hard part. A source that sent duplicates, a schema that changed under you, two teams who meant different things by "customer". You fixed it, and you'd design it differently now. Good engineering habits in Python, C# or another general-purpose language. Tested, modular code the next person can change without fear. An eye for SQL. You can read a query and tell whether it's right, whoever or whatever wrote it. Stayed on the hook for something after it went live. You found out why it broke, fixed the cause, and added what would have caught it sooner. Some time with CI/CD, Docker and cloud (we're on Azure). You've changed a pipeline, not just pushed to one. A habit of asking why. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you say so. AI as part of how you work, and you can explain and defend what it helped you build. Momentum. More ownership with each move, new stacks picked up quickly, things built that nobody asked for. jobs.title: Finance Director
jobs.description: About Codat Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work. Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time. The Role We're looking for a Finance Director to lead our finance team at Codat. You'll own the numbers from start to finish: the plan, the monthly close, the board pack and the conversations with our investors. This is both a hands-on role and a senior role. You'll have one direct report and still do plenty yourself: one day you'll be taking the board through the forecast, and the next you'll be sorting out a payroll query or approving expenses. You'll report to the Chief Legal and Business Officer and work closely with the leadership team on where we spend money and why, and you'll be the person who tells us when the numbers don't support a plan. What You'll Work On Budgeting, forecasting and cash. You'll build the annual and longer-range plan with budget holders across the business, keep the forecast current and track how we're doing against it. You’ll also own cash flow forecasting and runway, plus headcount planning with the people team. Board and investor reporting. You'll prepare the board pack, covering ARR, unit economics and customer metrics, and the analysis investors and advisers need. The month-end close, management accounts and statutory consolidation across our UK and US entities, including intercompany. You'll also run the annual audit to sign-off and own our technical accounting positions, such as revenue recognition and share-based payments. Group tax and compliance across the UK and US, and our relationships with auditors, tax advisers, lawyers and banks. ARR and revenue modelling. You’ll partner with the team to ensure our commercial reporting keeps pace as the business evolves, covering the impact of product and pricing changes, and the bridge from ARR to recognised revenue. jobs.description: <h1>Growth at Private Equity Insights</h1> <p>The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?</p> <p>Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.</p> <p>The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.</p> <p>You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.</li> <li><strong>Unlimited growth potential. </strong>You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.</li> <li><strong>Skills that compound for life.</strong> Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.</li> <li><strong>Ownership from the very start.</strong> You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.</li> <li><strong>Travel opportunity.</strong> You will be joining our 10+ conferences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <p>Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. Working closely with Sales and Account Management, we help build strong customer relationships and support Veriff's growth.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>The opportunity</strong></span></h2> <p>We're looking for a Lead Solutions Engineer to lead our Solutions Engineering team in EMEA. You'll combine technical expertise, people leadership, and commercial thinking to support enterprise customers, strengthen collaboration across teams, and drive business results in the region.</p> <p>You'll provide structure and direction to the team, improve how we work with customers and internal stakeholders, and help translate our go-to-market strategy into commercial success. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><sup><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span><a href="https://poly.ai?utm_source=prnewswire&amp;utm_medium=pressrelease&amp;utm_campaign=boilerplate&amp;utm_content=pressrelease" target="_blank">PolyAI</a></span> is the Agentic Dialog Platform for building the conversational enterprise, used to build, run, govern, and improve dialog agents at scale. We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market. At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done. Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies. The role You lead how Sparta builds software in the AI era. You own our AI-native software development lifecycle: the development agents engineers work alongside, the CI/CD that ships their code, and the testing strategy that lets us move fast without breaking trading workflows. Run enablement, write the playbooks, pair with teams and turn good practice from one team into the default for all of engineering. jobs.title: Responsable de Projets Conception Bâtiment
jobs.description: À propos d'ELCIMAI Elcimaï Ingénierie recrute : Un Responsable de projets conception bâtiment H/F en CDI Lieu : Melun (77) - Proche de la gare de Melun - 25 min de Paris Gare de Lyon (ligne R ou D) En tant que Responsable de Projets Conception Bâtiment, votre rôle principal est de piloter et produire la conception technique de projets industriels complexes. Véritable référent en maîtrise d'œuvre de conception, vous intervenez dès les études amont pour définir les solutions techniques les plus pertinentes et garantir la faisabilité, la performance et la qualité des projets. Vos missions : concevoir, expertiser, coordonner Vous prenez en charge les études de conception sur l'ensemble des phases de maîtrise d'œuvre : faisabilité, APS, APD et DCE, avec une forte implication dans les choix techniques structurants des projets en conception. Vous êtes le référent technique bâtiment et génie civil auprès des clients et des équipes projets. Vous pilotez ou produisez les études de conception en intégrant les contraintes d'exploitation, de maintenance, de réglementation, de sécurité et de performance environnementale. Vous coordonnez les différents intervenants techniques (structure, fluides, process industriels, architecture, économie de la construction...) pour garantir la cohérence globale des solutions proposées. Vous réalisez les arbitrages technico-économiques et analysez les risques afin d'optimiser les projets dès les phases amont. Vous assurez la relation client sur les aspects techniques et accompagnez les prises de décision tout au long de la conception. Vous pilotez les budgets, les délais et les aspects contractuels du projet. Vous supervisez les phases de réalisation et garantissez la conformité des ouvrages aux études de conception validées. Selon la nature et l'envergure des projets, vous pourrez être responsable de la coordination des phases EXE (VISA, synthèse) et DET jusqu'à la réception des ouvrages Votre profil : Ingénieur Bâtiment / Génie Civil (Bac+5), Architecte DPLG ou HMONP, ou équivalent. Expérience confirmée en maîtrise d'œuvre sur des projets de bâtiments industriels, avec une expertise reconnue en conception technique. Expertise indispensable en conception MOE, avec une parfaite maîtrise des phases Faisabilité, APS et APD en Génie Civil et TCE. Le candidat devra justifier d'une expérience avérée dans le pilotage et la production d'études de conception complexes, depuis les études amont jusqu'à la finalisation des dossiers de conception. La gestion de projet constitue un prolongement naturel de votre expertise technique en conception ; vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à analyser, concevoir et structurer des projets complexes. Capacité à piloter plusieurs projets simultanément avec méthode et organisation. Aisance relationnelle et capacité à défendre des choix techniques auprès des clients et partenaires. Vous êtes avant tout un concepteur expérimenté en bâtiment industriel et souhaitez mettre votre expertise technique au service de projets durables ? Rejoignez Elcimaï Ingénierie pour concevoir les sites industriels de demain. Intégrer le pôle Conseil, Architecture et Ingénierie d'ELCIMAI au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire qui a à cœur d'intervenir sur des projets à forte valeur technique et environnementale. Rejoindre une équipe à taille humaine (plus d'une vingtaine de collaborateurs) dans la Business Unit de Melun, tout en bénéficiant de la force d'un groupe de 360 personnes. Profiter d'un cadre de travail convivial : RTT, titres restaurant, charte de télétravail. Contribuer à des projets industriels responsables : décarbonation, optimisation des consommations, réduction des impacts environnementaux. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

You’ll fit in well if Experience: 1+ years in B2C customer care, support, hospitality, or any role where you dealt directly with customers. You will be expected to think rigorously, move fast, and communicate with clarity in a company where the stakes are real and the pace is unrelenting. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ? En tant que Spécialiste Support Services Financiers, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base clients qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de sa gestion comptable et financière. Grâce à ta maîtrise de l’allemand et du français, tu accompagnes les clients et traites leurs demandes dans ces deux langues, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne, en lien avec nos équipes internes. Tu contribues ainsi à leur offrir une expérience de support claire, réactive et adaptée à leurs besoins. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et l'équipe Support. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent. Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou une solution à ton interlocuteur ou, quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu prends en charge les demandes des clients en allemand et en français, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne, et transmets les éléments utiles aux équipes internes. Tu assures le suivi des demandes jusqu’à leur résolution et veilles à communiquer de manière claire à chaque étape. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 3 premiers mois : Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe. Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements. Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

jobs.description: Our Vision & Products 🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship One of the Top Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 60 Million Users in 3 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next At EverAI , we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first . And we’re only just getting started! Our Team We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO. Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO] • 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership • Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) • Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO] • 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM • Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO] • 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth • Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal] • 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A • Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) • Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) • Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) Your Role Most LLM roles stop at experimentation. Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users. Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models . On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better. You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead , working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production. The problems are real: personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles. If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role. Key Responsibilities Fine-tune open-weight LLMs using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO Diagnose model failures and turn them into experiments. Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers Build training data and evals that directly shape what gets trained next Improve model behavior across personalization, consistency, tone, multilingual and group interactions Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible Your Qualifications You’ve personally post-trained open-weight LLMs for a user-facing product and shipped them to production You’ve worked where AI was core to the product or business , not an experimental side feature Fine-tuning is core to your experience Strong Python, PyTorch and Hugging Face , with hands-on GPU training and debugging You build data and evals yourself and make decisions from evidence You can take work beyond notebooks into production You use AI tools daily in your own engineering work You are fully comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit NSFW content , including harmful material when developing and evaluating moderation system Bonus points Experience with conversational AI, roleplay products, or highly personalized consumer AI Multilingual LLMs Moderation, safety, or adversarial testing Multimodal models Open-source LLM / post-training contributions Why EverAI? 📈 Exponential Growth : From 60M users in 3 years

jobs.title: Senior Data Collection Operator (FR)
jobs.description: About Genesis We are a full-stack general-purpose robot company, born across San Francisco, London and Paris and bound by a single mission: to make general-purpose robots a reality, unlocking infinite physical labor for the world and freeing people for creativity, exploration and the pursuits they love for their own sake. We're building the engine that will teach robots to do real work in the real world. We recently unveiled Eno, our wheeled, dexterous robot powered by our GENE foundation model and we are starting to put it to work with real customers. The role General-purpose robots learn from real, dexterous human work, the kind of data that does not exist on the internet. We capture it with our own collection hardware: a person wears it, does the work, and the robot learns to do it too. You will be a senior member of the team scaling our data collection operation in Paris, working closely with our Paris research and engineering teams and with the operation in the Bay Area. You will help lead the day-to-day execution and quality bar on the Paris floor while remaining deeply hands-on with data collection, teleoperation, task setup, and real-robot testing. You will wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and take ownership of complex collection requests from setup through execution and quality review. You will work shoulder to shoulder with our model engineering and research teams, turning their requests into physical demonstrations and feeding what you learn on the floor back to them. You will be expected to operate autonomously, help guide and train other operators and contribute to how the Paris operation evolves as the team grows. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will not just run existing tasks: you will help shape how they are executed, how quality is measured, and how other operators are trained to deliver consistently. What you will do Help lead the Paris data collection floor. Set the execution and quality bar for day-to-day collection work and help the team scale effectively. Own complex collection setups. Take a loosely defined request and turn it into a working, repeatable collection task, including the setup, fixtures, props, environment, and procedure, with minimal support from engineering. Create high-quality training data. Wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and produce precise demonstrations that can be used to train our models. Own the full collection workflow. Go beyond collecting the data itself: review and quality-check your work, identify unusable episodes, support annotation, and help ensure that what reaches research is trainable data. Build repeatable tasks. Turn new collection requests into clear, repeatable processes that can be executed consistently by other operators. Partner with research and model engineering. Translate their requests into physical collection tasks, share observations from the floor, and iterate with them on setups and collection strategy. Improve the operation. Identify when a fixture, station layout, procedure, or collection method can be improved and proactively help implement those improvements. Write and improve the playbook. Own SOPs, quality checks, and training materials that allow the Paris operation to scale while maintaining a consistent quality bar. Guide other operators. Help onboard, train, and mentor operators and reinforce consistent execution across the team. Run real-robot testing. Partner with reliability and engineering teams to test robots on the floor, document what you observe, and help surface issues. Own quality. Review your own work and the team's, take direct feedback, and keep raising the bar. What we are looking for You have done precise, repetitive physical work to a high quality bar and can explain what made your work good and how you measured it. This could include data collection, teleoperation, motion capture, robotics lab work, assembly, fine craft, or another hands-on technical environment. Hands-on robo
