jobs.title: Software Test Engineer 80–100%
jobs.description: As our Software Test Engineer at machineMD in Bern, you’ll bring your engineering skills to a practical challenge: making complex systems easier to test. You’ll design and build test automation, connect tools and technologies, and explore how agentic workflows can improve the way we work. Our existing infrastructure gives you a starting point, with the freedom to extend it and introduce new approaches. You’ll work alongside developers, requirements engineers, and testers, taking responsibility for solutions from design to daily use. About machineMD We’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our signature product, neos™, is the world’s first non-invasive neuro-ophthalmoscope for fast, automated assessment of eye movements and pupils. Founded at the University Hospital of Bern, Switzerland, we’ve grown into a startup of 25 engineers, clinicians, scientists, and specialists working side by side. We aim to bring the diagnostic quality of highly trained specialists into secondary and primary care settings everywhere. The Role You’ll help us understand how neos™ behaves when its components work together—and where they fail. You’ll design and build the test systems, agentic workflows, and tooling that make complex behaviour reproducible and failures easier to diagnose. You’ll work alongside developers and use the domain expertise and manual testing provided by requirements engineers and testers. Pragmatic Improvements – assess our current testing setup with the team, identify the biggest weaknesses, and tackle them step by step. Build on what works, try useful approaches, and let a broader test concept grow from the improvements you put into practice. Engineer the Next Generation of Test Automation – build intelligent, agent-powered systems that redefine how complex software is tested. Go beyond UI testing, architect autonomous workflows, experiment with cutting-edge AI technologies, and turn bold ideas into production-ready solutions. Own the test automation stack. Build, break, innovate. Test Infrastructure – build on and improve our physical and software-based test environments. Introduce tools and setups where they make testing more effective, and keep them documented so tests remain repeatable and usable by others. Coordination & Code Quality – work hands-on with developers to implement automation, coordinate contributions, and review the quality of test code. Connect individual improvements so our testing becomes more consistent and easier to extend over time. Verification & Validation – contribute to V&V plans, protocols, reports, and evidence, and coordinate activities with the relevant specialists. Help keep testing, requirements, and documentation aligned in a medical device environment. What We Look For Experience Solid practical experience in software engineering, including designing, implementing, debugging, and maintaining software. You can understand existing codebases and develop clear, well-structured solutions that others can maintain and extend. Experience with some of our core technologies (Python, C#/.NET, C++ and Flutter/Dart) is a plus. Python and pytest are particularly useful for test automation, and you’re willing to learn the technologies needed for the task. Practical experience developing automated tests across different system levels, with the programming skills to implement, understand, and review test code. Experience building or integrating agentic workflows is a plus. Experience with verification and validation of medical devices or familiarity with ISO 13485 is a plus. Qualifications Solid software testing fundamentals at ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent knowledge, including test planning, test design, and requirements coverage. Vocational training or a higher degree in computer science, software engineering, medical informatics, or a related technical field. Fluent English (minimum strong B2, ideally C1); German

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer (NL)
jobs.description: Functie  Reliability engineer   Beschrijving functie   De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets.  De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden.   De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren.  Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken.   Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn. Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf. Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren. Foutenboom analyse: onderzoek van een systeem fout door naar de kleinere voorafgaande gebeurtenissen te kijken die hebben bijgedragen aan de systeem fout Taken Trouble shooting Faciliteren van root cause analyse in geval van complexe, multidisciplinaire afwijkingen/storingen waar de uitvoerende teams niet uitkomen Daily problem solving Continue verbeteren Periodieke analyse op performance killers en cost drivers om van daaruit middels verbetervoorstellen bij te dragen aan een maximale beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid van installaties tegen minimale kosten Innovatief denken m.b.t. het verlagen van de kosten en verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid Leiden/faciliteren van verbeterteams c.q. verbeterprojecten Change Management Beoordelen van wijzigingen op technische haalbaarheid met het bestaande machinepark. Vanuit procurement komen verzoeken op het gebied van grondstof wijzigingen ( andere leverancier, andere specificaties ed.)  Begeleiden van proeven vanuit de technische kant op de machines Installatie nieuwe machines / introductie nieuwe producten  Technische beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid Evalueren van preventief onderhoud en voorstellen doen ter verbetering met als doel het verhogen van de beschikbaarheid van het machinepark Het verlagen van onderhoudskosten door het optimaliseren van onderhoudsconcepten en doorvoeren van technische verbeteringen. Investeringsprojecten Participeren in investeringsprojecten om de onderhoudbaarheid te borgen en het inregelen van onderhoud en spare parts. Inbrengen van technische kennis en ervaringen. Toezien op naleving van de standaard op gebied van onderdelen en installaties. jobs.title: Security Architect
jobs.description: Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.     Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters   At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas:  Physical/embedded device security.  OT (operational technology) network security.  OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications.  Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.   What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun.  As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact.  What you will be doing   As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments.  As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors.  Security standards, policies, and design patterns library  Security architecture review process  Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation  Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register  Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services.  Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies)  Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape  Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites.  Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.   To succeed in this role:   You are pass

jobs.title: Sr. Engineering Manager - Developer Ecosystem
jobs.description: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">RDQ427R369</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.</span></p> <p>Our Developer Ecosystem organisation shapes how developers and the AI agents working for them build on the Databricks Data and AI Platform, from within the product to the tools they already use.</p> <p>We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our declarative deployment framework, which turns data and AI projects into versioned, reviewable, repeatable software. It is one product with two entry points. Third-party developers use our open-source CLI from their IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD systems. First-party, they author, deploy and inspect the same projects inside the Databricks workspace. In both, AI agents increasingly do the work: coding agents drive the CLI, and our in-product AI assistant authors and deploys projects alongside the developer. Thousands of organisations run their CI/CD on it, and it is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform.</p> <p>The team owns the deployment engine and CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and the metadata service and deployment history that record every deployment. The hard problems are real infrastructure-as-code problems: reconciling declared and live state, making plans safe for humans and agents to approve, keeping visual authoring and code in sync, and shipping weekly releases that remain backwards-compatible for our largest customers.</p> <p><strong>The impact you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and grow the team:</strong> Manage a team of senior engineers across three closely connected areas (the deployment engine and open-source CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and deployment history and metadata), working with strong tech leads. Hire, coach and promote, and grow engineers into tech leads.</li> <li><strong>Make agentic development the default path:</strong> Shape how developers and AI agents author, validate and deploy projects, both inside the workspace and from the developer's own coding agent. Design the tools, skills and guardrails so agents get the same safety and auditability as humans.</li> <li><strong>Own the strategy and roadmap:</strong> Partner with Product and Design to set a multi-quarter roadmap for declarative deployment: agentic development, governed deployments and deployment history, enterprise CI/CD, and new resource coverage. Make the trade-offs explicit when the demand is larger than the team.</li> <li><strong>Raise the bar on execution and operational excellence:</strong> Run a predictable delivery process for a fast-moving, open-source product with frequent releases. Own reliability, on-call health, incident response and the quality bar for a tool customers depend on to ship to production.</li> <li><strong>Treat backward compatibility as a product feature:</strong> Lead engine and configuration migrations without forcing customers through a flag day, and communicate change clearly to customers, the community and field teams.</li> <li><strong>Lead across the platform:</strong> Drive alignment with the many platform teams whose resources and services the framework deploys, and with our sibling teams in Developer Ecosystem (SDKs, CLI, IaC provider, IDE). Make the whole toolchain feel like one product.</li> </ul> <p><strong

jobs.title: Order & Delivery Coordinator (C-UAS)
jobs.description: Your next mission Anchor our system deliveries. Connect internal teams seamlessly – so our life-saving radars reach the front lines without delay. As our Order & Delivery Coordinator (C-UAS), you run the administrative engine behind dispatching our IRIS radar systems. You take charge of order flows in Odoo ERP, align documentation, and organise clean internal handovers from Operations to dispatch readiness. Working alongside Project Management, Customer Success, and Operations, you keep our internal gears turning smoothly. Your sharp attention to detail ensures our teams stay focused and our radars deploy on schedule. What you'll do Order processing and data integrity : Process incoming sales orders in Odoo ERP across the entire lifecycle. Verify system data, hardware configurations, and commercial terms with high accuracy. Maintain order statuses, serial numbers, and delivery confirmations daily. Compliance and export documentation : Compile and verify complete delivery documentation packages before dispatch. Review export control paperwork, QA certificates, shipping manifests, and packing lists. Ensure every system leaves our premises with watertight paperwork. Logistics coordination and internal handovers : Coordinate handovers with the Warehouse and Logistics crew with complete shipping files. Monitor dispatch statuses once Operations releases each radar system. Keep internal handovers structured, clean, and ready for physical freight execution. Cross-functional status tracking : Supply real-time ERP delivery status updates to Project Management and Customer Success. Share accurate tracking data and handover packages across departments. Monitor administrative workflows proactively to eliminate handover bottlenecks and protect dispatch targets. jobs.title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place. We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting) with 25+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel. And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way. Polarsteps has over 23 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey. Want to know more about us? Here you go. Your expedition at Polarsteps - Senior Data & Analytics Engineer Over the past 10+ years, Polarsteps has grown massively through word-of-mouth, thanks to our product and tech department building a top-quality user experience for all our travelers. As our first Senior Data & Analytics Engineer, you'll own the foundation that every data-driven decision at Polarsteps is built on. Product & growth teams run experiments and analyse the data every week, leadership need clear reports for investors, and all of that depends on data that is reliable, modelled and compliant. You'll set the direction for our data platform, bring structure to data governance, and own the data infra that helps our product managers, marketers and data scientists do their job even better. You'll work closely with the Head of Engineering on infrastructure and architecture, and with the Head of Growth and product teams on what the business needs from data. jobs.title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support (Detachering / ZZP)
jobs.description: Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren.  Wie ben jij Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.   Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.   Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.   Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.   Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers. Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat. Wat ga je doen Wat breng je mee? Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen. •    Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;    Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen; •    Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn; •    Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee; •    Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren; •    Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn; •    Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving; •    Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is; •    Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau. Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré. Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en priori

jobs.title: Senior R&D Engineer/Projectleider Flight Test and Certification (m/v/x)
jobs.description: Ben jij op zoek naar een  uitdagende baan  in de wereld van de lucht- en ruimtevaart? En.....ben je die R&D engineer die helpt civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Door aan vliegtuigen te meten en te testen om alles te weten te komen?  Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie, veiligheid en duurzaamheid? Dan spreken we je graag! Wat ga je doen? Als Senior R&D engineer Flight Test en Certificatie werk je mee aan het veiliger, duurzamer en competitiever maken van de militaire en civiele luchtvaart. Je werkt aan vliegtuigen, helikopters en onbemande vliegende systemen. Om onze binnen- en buitenlandse opdrachtgevers te ondersteunen in het bereiken van hun doelen voer je testen uit en analyseert de resultaten, je toetst wijzigingen aan vliegtuigen aan de regelgeving in het kader van veilig vliegen en je ontwikkelt nieuwe regelgeving om innovatieve technieken te implementeren. Je bedenkt en werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen samen met collega’s en andere R&D instituten in een (inter-) nationale setting. Je leidt projecten, hebt veel klantcontact (intern en extern) en werkt met zelfsturende teams, in wisselende samenstelling. Je voert projectwerk uit, je coördineert werkpakketten en je initieert met je collega’s nieuwe projecten. Het werken bij Koninklijke NLR kenmerkt zich door variatie en dynamische werkverbanden. Onze missie is om nieuwe technologie praktisch en veilig toepasbaar te maken en daarmee de Nederlandse (en Europese) industrie en overheid te helpen om voorop te lopen. We geven goed onderbouwde adviezen aan beleidsbepalers, ontwikkelaars en gebruikers. Wat breng je mee? Afgeronde WO master in een technische richting zoals luchtvaarttechniek, elektrotechniek of informatica; Tenminste 5 jaren relevante werkervaring; Ontwikkeling van lucht- en ruimtevaarttuigen en klimaat neutrale luchtvaart spreken je aan als werkgebieden; De ambitie om expert te worden op het gebied van flight test en certificatie; Affiniteit met werken voor Defensie, en liefst kennis van de Defensie organisatie; Bewezen capaciteiten als projectleider voor grote projecten; In staat zijn om klantenwensen te vertalen en een brug te slaan tussen techniek en operationele impact; Positieve instelling, initiatiefrijk, flexibel, resultaatgericht; Communicatief vaardig in het Nederlands en Engels (tenminste op C1 niveau) Wat bieden wij jou? Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightech omgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé. Verder bieden wij jou onder anderen: 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek); 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer; Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA, als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden; De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving De afdeling Flight Test en Certificatie (ASTC) richt zich op het ondersteunen van de Nederlandse overheid (Defensie, EZK, IenW) en markt waarin thema’s als "bescherming van de samenleving" en “Klimaat neutrale luchtvaart” belangrijke uitgangspunten zijn. We voeren experimenten en vliegproeven uit met onze eigen vliegtuigen, geschaalde vliegtuigen en drones. We ondersteunen vliegproeven met vliegtuigen van klanten. Dit kan zijn voor een onderzoek

jobs.title: Integration Test Engineer
jobs.description: Role - Integration Test Engineer Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy Location - Utrecht About iwell At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead. We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof.  We are a fast-growing international team of driven and collaborative talents, from engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. All our systems and their interactions within the larger energy ecosystem are thoroughly tested. We are serving a diverse customer base with strict demands, our services power business and key infrastructure. We demand that our products are subjected to a wide range of testing during the integration and development phase. We're seeking a talented and curious test engineer with a passion for sustainability and battery energy storage.  You will handle a wide variety of topics from different customer requirements and have a lot of freedom to develop the test methodology and strategy. You will work within the battery system team, where software and hardware come together in the products we develop for our customers.  We will rely on your experience, hands-on approach and judgment. You will be crucial in driving our mission of transitioning from fossil-fuel dependence. If you're passionate about sustainability and have the technical skills to bring our vision to life, we want to hear from you. What you will do Develop test campaigns based on internal and external requirements Discuss and present test results internally and externally Execute tests and document the result Support the integration of hardware components into iwell’s BESS, ensuring compatibility and performance. Develop and maintain technical documentation, such as system specifications,  processes, and instructions. You will become one of the practical system experts within iwell, interacting with field service, product development and engineering teams. What are looking for Degree in Electrical Engineering (HBO/WO) or equivalent experience. Experience in electrical design of high power and energy conversion systems. Knowledge of technical standards and grid operator connection requirements. Able to make the basic design for a site with energy production and storage, feeding into the Medium Voltage AC grid, including cable system design, PE system design and according to national installation guidelines. Strong communication skills and attention to quality assurance Ability to read and produce technical drawings and schematics Ability to speak and write German is a plus Note: at iwell, we value growth potential over perfection. A mobile phone allowance of EUR 25 per month Additional activitie

Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. Mistral's Solutions teams (Deployment Strategists and Forward Deployed Engineers) co-create high-value AI use cases with customers in these environments. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, demonstrating its impact, and scaling value across the institution. You will work with mission owners, program stakeholders, end users, security and IT teams, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support. jobs.description: About Welo Global Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com About the Role We're hiring a technically strong Senior Data Analyst to help modernize how our FP&A organization uses data, analytics, and automation. This is an embedded Finance role: you'll report directly to the FP&A Director and work side by side with her day to day while partnering closely with our central Data Analytics and Data Engineering teams on infrastructure, standards, and complex technical problems. It's a hands-on execution role for someone who builds. Financial and operational data at Welocalize lives across multiple systems - Workday Financials, Adaptive Planning, Salesforce, a Redshift data warehouse, Power BI, and years of Excel workbooks carrying critical processes. Much of it doesn't connect cleanly, and a lot of institutional knowledge lives in undocumented spreadsheets, manual processes, and Power Queries rather than any system of record. We're just starting to build out an FP&A AI repository - documentation, business logic, and workflows meant to let AI reliably execute FP&A processes, not just answer one-off questions - and you'll partner with us to determine its direction. This role is a deliberate combination of three things: 1. Fluency with data itself - the ability to query, shape, and manipulate data directly. 2. An engineering mindset - building automated, repeatable systems (workflows and dashboards that run and refresh on their own, integrations across tools) rather than one-off analysis, and knowing how to scope and coordinate real pipeline or data mart work with Data Engineering. 3. An investigative instinct - the ability to look at data and figure out what it's telling us, not just execute a report exactly as specified. Support preparation of materials for regulatory submissions, audits, and design-control activities as appropriate. jobs.description: Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. You'd be joining the Artificial Intelligence team . We own the algorithmic core of the platform: Predictions, Contextual Personalization, contextual bandits, autosegmentation, and the agentic workflows behind Loomi. We work with behavioural data at terabyte scale, across 1,400+ customers, in production, every day. We are currently allowing flexibility for our employees to work from anywhere for the respective region (Central & Eastern Europe) or we are happy to meet you in our offices in Bratislava (Slovakia) or Brno, Prague (Czechia) on a full-time basis. The mission You find the signal in how 1,400 brands' customers actually behave — and you prove it moved a business metric. Your models decide which customers are predicted to churn, which segments form themselves, which offer a shopper sees, and whether the discount changed anything or was going to convert anyway. What you'll actually do Frame the problem before modelling it. Most of our highest-impact work arrives as a vague business question, and turning it into something measurable is the first job. Work the data at scale. Behavioural data, product catalogues and event streams across BigQuery and Databricks — finding features that carry real predictive signal, not the ones that are easy to compute. Build and evaluate models across Predictions and Contextual Personalization: propensity and churn, contextual bandits, autosegmentation, uplift and incrementality. Design the evaluation, not just the model. Offline metrics, backtests, and the A/B design that decides whether this ships. You own the question "how would we know if this is worse?" Bring methods in from outside and judge them honestly — read the literature, run the quick PoC, and tell a real result from a well-marketed one. Hand off cleanly to ML Engineering. You own the model and the evidence; they own making it survive production. That handoff is a document and a conversation, not a notebook over a wall. Explain your results to people who aren't data scientists — Product, Engineering leadership, and sometimes customers. What success looks like after 12 months Two models you built are in production and you can name the business metric each one moved. A question the team was arguing about is settled, with evidence, and your writeup is what people link to. ML Engineering describes your handoffs as easy. ML product engineering — you own an ML-powered feature end to end and the ML part is what makes it interesting. Platform & MLOps — pipelines, serving, deployment, observability, inference cost. jobs.description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The Role: Build the data, decisioning and automated systems that allow Paddle to take more good risk while reducing fraud losses, unnecessary customer friction and manual work. Paddle’s Merchant of Record model makes risk a critical part of the product and its economics. Seller quality, buyer fraud, payment acceptance, refunds, disputes, reserves and card-scheme exposure cannot be optimised independently. This role will connect those signals, identify where the largest value is being lost, turn risk priorities into working controls and workflows, prove their effect in production, and establish a durable owner once a capability becomes repeatable. This is not a strategy-only role and it is not ownership of a large operational team. It is a hands-on build role at the intersection of risk, data, product, engineering and operations. What you'll do: Work hands-on with SQL (Snowflake, dbt), Python, statistics and modern AI-assisted tools to explore data, test hypotheses, prototype controls and evaluate results. Map the end-to-end seller risk system, its data, decisions, controls, owners and failure points. Establish the baseline before building: fraud losses, alert yield, time-to-detect, exposure at detection and analyst effort, with losses reconciled with Finance. Own the health of live controls: every rule and check has an owner, an expected volume, a measured yield and alerting when it goes quiet or drifts, and every change is tested and impact-assessed before release. Build and maintain a labelled library of confirmed fraud cases and a shared fraud typology: the basis for rules now and for machine-learning models with Data Science later. Build a value-ranked portfolio of risk opportunities. Translate risk problems into clear product, data and engineering work with measurable acceptance criteria. Design seller risk tiers that set payout timing, reserves and limits, giving good sellers more room and tightening controls on riskier ones. Backtest rules and risk scores on point-in-time data, and design control experiments, shadow tests and phased roll-outs that measure both loss reduction and legitimate-customer impact. Produce decision artefacts that let senior leaders make trade-offs about risk appetite, engineering investment, customer experience and commercial growth. Stay with each major capability until it works in production, then establish its long-term owner and move to the next high-value problem. Expected 6 month outcomes: At least one major seller-risk journey has materially improved on agreed loss, approval, speed or manual-effort measures. Fraud/Risk Operations spends significantly less time on repetitive screening and more time on investigation, judgement and improvement. Stable capabilities have been handed to durable owners, leaving the role free to take on the next high-value problems. We'd love to hear from you if you: Significant experience building or improving merchant- or seller-side fraud detection at a PSP, acquirer, payfac, marketplace or Merchant of Record, and a working knowledge of how bust-out, transaction laundering and self-dealing show up in the data. Strong hands-on analytical ability, fluency in SQL (Snowflake, dbt or similar), Python and statistics, plus experience using LLMs on unstructured data such as website content or support tickets, with measured accuracy. NON-ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS Coordinate and facilitate teleconferences and meetings, as required. Perform other duties as directed by the Modeling Supervisor and the Principal Investigator. Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again". This role owns how our sales process works across Direct-to-Consumer, Physician Partnerships, and Enterprise — how work flows, what the systems are asked to do, and what the sales organization sees when it opens them. It is the person who finds where reps lose time, designs a better way, and drives it into practice. This role reports to the Director, Commercial Strategy and Operations and works as a close building partner to our Sales Operations Manager. The two roles design the commercial operating infrastructure together, with the Specialist bringing hands-on execution, workflow design, and a constant eye on where the process is costing reps time. This is a partnership, not a support function — you are expected to bring your own point of view on how things should work, not wait to be handed specifications. How we work with Salesforce. Our IT team owns and maintains the Salesforce platform. Commercial owns the design: we determine what the business needs the system to do, build the proposals and requirements behind those changes, and partner with IT to implement them. This role works hands-on in the surface layer — reports, dashboards, list views, and the configuration available to us — and specifies everything deeper. Success here depends as much on writing a clear, well-justified proposal and shepherding it through a queue you do not control as it does on building things yourself. The role also extends this thinking beyond Sales Operations. The same discipline — map the workflow, find the friction, redesign it, measure whether it helped — applies wherever the commercial organization touches other functions, including handoffs with Marketing, Clinical, Finance, Legal, and Sales Enablement. Where a process spans teams, this role is expected to see the whole of it rather than only the Sales-shaped part. Prenuvo 's commercial function is still being built, so there is real ownership available here. The processes you design will be the ones the sales organization runs on as it scales. This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future). Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives! What You'll Do Workflow Design and Rep Efficiency Map how work actually flows through the sales process today across each channel, and identify where reps lose time to manual steps, duplicate entry, unclear handoffs, or waiting on someone else. Design improvements to sales workflows — automation, validation, templated processes, streamlined approvals, better-structured records — that measurably reduce the administrative burden on reps. Sit with reps and sales leaders regularly to understand where the process gets in their way, and translate what you hear into specific, well-defined change proposals. Apply the same workflow discipline to processes that extend beyond Sales Operations, partnering with Marketing, Clinical, Finance, Legal, and Sales Enablement to remove friction at the handoff points between teams. Track the time and effort cost of process changes, and be honest about which ones worked and which added complexity without benefit.
